history.q: What did the king of Babylon do to Zedekiah after killing his sons at Riblah?
options: Made him a servant of the temple
Sent him back to rule Judah
history.explain: The king of Babylon killed Zedekiah's sons in front of him, then blinded him, bound him, and took him to Babylon.

history.q: Which Babylonian king released Jehoiachin from prison and gave him a seat of honor?
history.explain: In the 37th year of Jehoiachin's exile, Evil-merodach freed him from prison and gave him a seat higher than the other kings.

history.q: Who was appointed governor over the people left in Judah after Jerusalem fell?
history.explain: The king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah governor over the people he left in Judah.

history.q: At which gate of Jerusalem did Ezra read the Law to the people?
history.explain: Ezra read the Law aloud to the people in the open square before the Water Gate from early morning until midday.

history.q: Which opponent of Nehemiah was an Ammonite official?
history.explain: Tobiah the Ammonite official was displeased that someone had come to help Israel, and he opposed Nehemiah along with Sanballat.

history.q: Haman, the enemy of the Jews, is called an "Agagite". What does this name connect him to?
history.explain: Haman is called an Agagite, linking him to Agag, the Amalekite king Saul had spared, an old enemy of Israel.

history.q: How high was the gallows Haman built for Mordecai?
history.explain: Haman built gallows fifty cubits high for Mordecai, but ended up hanged on them himself.

history.q: Which of David's mighty men fought until his hand was weary and clung to his sword?
history.explain: Eleazar son of Dodo kept fighting the Philistines until his hand was weary and stuck to his sword, and the LORD brought a great victory.

history.q: How many wives and concubines did Solomon have, who turned his heart from the LORD?
history.explain: Solomon had 700 wives, who were princesses, and 300 concubines, and they turned his heart away from the LORD.

history.q: Which commander killed King Elah of Israel and reigned only seven days?
history.explain: Zimri, a commander of Elah's chariots, killed King Elah at Tirzah and reigned only seven days.

history.q: What name did Phinehas's wife give her newborn son, meaning "the glory has departed"?
history.explain: After the ark was captured and her husband and father-in-law died, she named her newborn son Ichabod, meaning the glory has departed.

history.q: Who was the last king of Israel before Samaria fell to Assyria?
history.explain: Hoshea was the last king of Israel; in his ninth year Assyria captured Samaria.

history.q: Under which Persian king was the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem completed?
history.explain: The Jews finished building the temple in the sixth year of King Darius and dedicated it with joy.

history.q: What did Hannah promise God about her son if He gave her one?
history.a: He would serve the LORD all his life
options: He would serve the LORD all his life
history.explain: Hannah vowed to give her son to the LORD all the days of his life, 1 Samuel 1:11.

history.q: What did the Queen of Sheba bring to Solomon on camels?
history.explain: She came with camels carrying spices, very much gold, and precious stones, 1 Kings 10:2.

history.q: Who told Naaman's wife about the prophet in Samaria who could heal him?
history.explain: A little girl captured from Israel served Naaman's wife and told her about the prophet, 2 Kings 5:2-3.

history.q: What did Jonathan give David as a sign of their friendship?
history.explain: Jonathan made a covenant with David and gave him his robe, sword, and bow, 1 Samuel 18:3-4.

history.q: What appeared and separated Elijah and Elisha just before Elijah went up to heaven?
history.a: A chariot and horses of fire
options: A chariot and horses of fire
history.explain: A chariot of fire and horses of fire parted the two men, 2 Kings 2:11.

history.q: How did the 300 men God chose for Gideon's army drink water?
history.a: They lapped it with their tongues like a dog
options: They lapped it with their tongues like a dog
They poured it on the ground
history.explain: The LORD chose the 300 who lapped the water with their tongues like a dog, Judges 7:5-7.

history.q: About how long did the sun stand still during the battle at Gibeon?
history.explain: The sun did not hurry to set for about a whole day, Joshua 10:13.

history.q: What did King Josiah do when he heard the words of the Book of the Law read aloud?
history.explain: Josiah tore his clothes in sorrow when he heard the Law, 2 Kings 22:11.

history.q: How did Nehemiah respond when he heard Jerusalem's walls were broken down?
history.explain: Nehemiah sat down and wept, mourned, fasted, and prayed before God, Nehemiah 1:4.

history.q: What did Elisha tell the poor widow to borrow from her neighbors?
history.explain: Elisha told her to borrow many empty vessels, then God filled them with oil, 2 Kings 4:3.

history.q: In Solomon's famous judgment, who did Solomon decide was the baby's real mother?
history.a: The woman who begged him to spare the baby
options: The woman who offered him money
The woman who begged him to spare the baby
The woman who spoke the loudest
history.explain: The true mother's heart yearned for her son, so Solomon gave the baby to her, 1 Kings 3:26-27.

history.q: What did Rahab ask the Israelite spies to promise her?
options: To make her queen of Jericho
history.explain: She asked them to save alive her father, mother, brothers, sisters, and all theirs, Joshua 2:12-13.

history.q: What sweet food did Jonathan taste that put him in danger from his father Saul's oath?
history.explain: Jonathan, not hearing his father's oath, dipped his staff in a honeycomb and ate, 1 Samuel 14:27.

history.q: Rehoboam said his father had disciplined the people with whips, but he would use what?
history.explain: Rehoboam threatened to chastise them with scorpions, 1 Kings 12:11.

history.q: What did Jael give tired Sisera to drink in her tent?
history.explain: Sisera asked for water, but Jael opened a skin of milk and gave him a drink, Judges 4:19.

history.q: What did King Ahab want to make out of Naboth's vineyard?
history.explain: Ahab wanted the vineyard to use as a garden of herbs, 1 Kings 21:2.

history.q: Who was Hannah's husband?
history.explain: Elkanah was the husband of Hannah, 1 Samuel 1:1-2.

history.q: Whom did Esther invite to her banquet along with the king?
history.explain: Esther asked the king to come with Haman to the banquet she had prepared, Esther 5:4.

history.q: What were the twelve stones set up at Gilgal meant to remind future children of?
history.a: Israel crossing the Jordan on dry ground
options: Israel crossing the Jordan on dry ground
history.explain: The stones were to tell children how Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground, Joshua 4:21-24.

history.q: Who could flee to the cities of refuge?
history.a: A person who killed someone accidentally
options: A person who killed someone accidentally
A thief running from the law
A soldier who left the army
history.explain: These cities protected one who killed a person unintentionally from the avenger, Joshua 20:2-3.

history.q: How many times did Samson give Delilah a false answer about his strength before telling her the truth?
history.explain: He lied with green cords, new ropes, and the woven locks before revealing the secret, Judges 16:7-17.

history.q: What was the first sign Gideon asked for with the fleece?
history.a: Dew on the fleece only, with the ground dry
options: Dew on the fleece only, with the ground dry
Rain on the threshing floor only
The fleece turning white as snow
history.explain: Gideon asked that dew be on the fleece alone while all the ground stayed dry, Judges 6:36-38.

history.q: Which enemy did Jephthah lead Israel against?
history.explain: Jephthah crossed over to fight the Ammonites and the LORD gave them into his hand, Judges 11:32.

history.q: At which mountain did Barak gather his troops before the battle against Sisera?
history.explain: Barak was told to lead 10,000 men up to Mount Tabor, Judges 4:6.

history.q: To which Israelite town did the two cows pull the ark of God on its way back from the Philistines?
history.explain: The cows went straight up the road to Beth Shemesh, 1 Samuel 6:12.

history.q: What did Eli the priest wrongly think was the matter with Hannah as she prayed silently?
history.explain: Her lips moved but her voice was not heard, so Eli thought she was drunk, 1 Samuel 1:13-14.

history.q: At Gilgal, what did Saul do that cost his family the throne?
history.a: Offered the sacrifice himself instead of waiting for Samuel
options: Offered the sacrifice himself instead of waiting for Samuel
history.explain: Saul offered the burnt offering himself and Samuel told him his kingdom would not continue, 1 Samuel 13:9-14.

history.q: How did King Saul die on Mount Gilboa?
history.a: He fell on his own sword
options: He was struck down by an angel
He was killed by David's men
He fell on his own sword
history.explain: Badly wounded, Saul fell on his own sword, 1 Samuel 31:4.

history.q: How did Jonathan secretly warn David that Saul wanted to kill him?
history.explain: Jonathan shot arrows and used a pre-arranged signal with his boy to tell David, 1 Samuel 20:20-22.

history.q: Whom did Abigail marry after her husband Nabal died?
history.explain: David sent for Abigail and she became his wife, 1 Samuel 25:39-42.

history.q: Which of David's trusted counselors joined Absalom's rebellion?
history.explain: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counselor, 2 Samuel 15:12.

history.q: Into which part of Solomon's temple did the priests bring the ark of the covenant?
history.a: The Most Holy Place, the inner sanctuary
options: The Most Holy Place, the inner sanctuary
history.explain: The priests brought the ark to its place in the Most Holy Place, 1 Kings 8:6.

history.q: Besides Judah, which tribe stayed loyal to Rehoboam?
history.explain: Rehoboam gathered the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, 1 Kings 12:21.

history.q: Why did Naboth refuse to sell his vineyard to Ahab?
history.a: It was the inheritance of his ancestors
options: He did not like the king's price
It was the inheritance of his ancestors
history.explain: Naboth said the LORD forbid he should give up the inheritance of his fathers, 1 Kings 21:3.

history.q: Who hid the infant Joash from wicked Queen Athaliah?
history.explain: Jehosheba, the king's daughter, took baby Joash and hid him, 2 Kings 11:2.

history.q: For how many years was Joash hidden in the temple before he was crowned?
history.explain: He was hidden with her in the house of the LORD six years while Athaliah ruled, 2 Kings 11:3.

history.q: Which feast did Josiah command Judah to keep, unlike any held since the days of the judges?
history.explain: No Passover like it had been kept since the time of the judges, 2 Kings 23:21-22.

history.q: How many banquets did Esther prepare for the king and Haman before the king's final judgment on Haman?
history.explain: Esther held one banquet, invited them to a second the next day, and revealed her request there, Esther 5-7.

history.q: Where did Ruth lie down at Boaz's feet at night?
history.explain: Ruth went down to the threshing floor and lay at Boaz's feet as Naomi instructed, Ruth 3:6-7.

history.q: How old was Caleb when Moses sent him to spy out the land?
history.explain: Caleb said he was forty years old when Moses sent him from Kadesh Barnea, Joshua 14:7.

history.q: Who won Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife by capturing Kiriath Sepher?
history.explain: Othniel son of Kenaz captured the city and received Achsah, Joshua 15:16-17.

history.q: How many cities of refuge in all were set apart in the land of Israel?
history.explain: Kedesh, Shechem, Hebron, Bezer, Ramoth, and Golan were appointed, Joshua 20:7-8.

history.q: Joshua commanded the moon to stand still over which valley?
history.explain: Joshua said, Moon, in the valley of Aijalon, Joshua 10:12.

history.q: What were the names of the two bronze pillars set up at the porch of Solomon's temple?
history.explain: Hiram set up the pillars and named them Jachin and Boaz, 1 Kings 7:21.

history.q: On which mountain did Solomon begin to build the temple?
history.explain: Solomon began to build the house of the LORD on Mount Moriah, 2 Chronicles 3:1.

history.q: Which rivers of Damascus did Naaman say were better than all the waters of Israel?
history.explain: Naaman said Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, were better than Israel's waters, 2 Kings 5:12.

history.q: Which king of Israel, a son of Ahab, did Jehu strike down with an arrow?
history.explain: Jehu drew his bow and shot Joram through the heart, 2 Kings 9:24.

history.q: What was Zedekiah's name before the king of Babylon changed it?
history.explain: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah king and changed his name to Zedekiah, 2 Kings 24:17.

history.q: Which gate of Jerusalem did the high priest Eliashib and his brothers rebuild first?
history.explain: Eliashib the high priest and his brothers rose up and built the Sheep Gate, Nehemiah 3:1.

history.q: How many elders did Boaz gather at the city gate as witnesses to redeem Ruth and Naomi's family land?
history.explain: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city and asked them to sit down, Ruth 4:2.

history.q: What did seven priests blow as they marched before the ark around Jericho?
history.explain: Seven priests carried trumpets of rams' horns before the ark, Joshua 6:4.

history.q: For the first six days, how many times did Israel march around Jericho each day?
history.explain: Joshua 6:3 says they went around the city once a day for six days.

history.q: What was wrong with the bread the Gibeonites carried to trick Israel?
history.explain: The Gibeonites carried dry, moldy bread to look like they had traveled far, Joshua 9:5.

history.q: After Israel found out the Gibeonites had tricked them, what job did Joshua give them?
history.explain: Joshua made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers, Joshua 9:21, 27.

history.q: Which left-handed judge delivered Israel from King Eglon of Moab?
history.explain: The LORD raised up Ehud, a left-handed man, to deliver Israel, Judges 3:15.

history.q: What did Gideon's 300 men break as they blew their trumpets at night?
history.explain: They blew the trumpets and broke the jars in their hands, Judges 7:19-20.

history.q: What was the widow of Zarephath gathering when Elijah asked her for water and bread?
history.explain: Elijah found her at the gate gathering sticks, 1 Kings 17:10.

history.q: How many times did Elijah stretch himself out over the widow's dead son before he came back to life?
history.explain: Elijah stretched himself on the child three times and prayed, 1 Kings 17:21.

history.q: What did the Shunammite woman and her husband build for the prophet Elisha?
history.explain: They made a little room on the wall for Elisha to stay in, 2 Kings 4:10.

history.q: Why was the man who lost the axe head so upset?
options: It was a gift from Elisha
history.explain: The man cried out, "Alas, my master! For it was borrowed," 2 Kings 6:5.

history.q: What did Elisha tell the king of Israel to give the blinded Syrian soldiers instead of killing them?
history.explain: Elisha said to set bread and water before them, 2 Kings 6:22.

history.q: What did Hezekiah's pool and conduit bring into Jerusalem?
history.explain: Hezekiah made a pool and a conduit and brought water into the city, 2 Kings 20:20.

history.q: How old was Manasseh when he became king of Judah?
history.explain: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, 2 Kings 21:1.

history.q: What happened to the idol Dagon the second morning after the ark was in his temple?
history.a: His head and hands were cut off
options: His head and hands were cut off
He was carried away by birds
history.explain: Dagon's head and both palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold, 1 Samuel 5:4.

history.q: What did Ehud hide under his clothes on his right thigh to use against Eglon?
history.explain: Ehud made a sword with two edges, a cubit long, and hid it on his right thigh, Judges 3:16.

history.q: What did Samson promise the thirty Philistine companions if they solved his riddle?
history.a: Thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes
options: Thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes
history.explain: Samson offered thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing, Judges 14:12.

history.q: Who pressed Samson until he explained the answer to his riddle?
history.explain: His wife wept and pressed him until he told her, Judges 14:16-17.

history.q: What did Jephthah vow to offer the LORD if he won the battle against the Ammonites?
history.a: Whatever first came out of his house to meet him
options: Whatever first came out of his house to meet him
All the spoil of the battle
history.explain: He vowed to offer whatever came out of his doors to meet him, Judges 11:31.

history.q: What did Boaz tell his young men to do so Ruth would gather more grain?
history.a: Let some grain fall on purpose for her
options: Chase her out of the field
Tell her to stop gleaning at noon
Let some grain fall on purpose for her
history.explain: Boaz said to pull out some stalks on purpose for her to glean, Ruth 2:16.

history.q: Which Philistine city first received the captured ark of God?
history.explain: The Philistines brought the ark from Ebenezer to Ashdod, 1 Samuel 5:1.

history.q: What did the LORD tell Samuel to take with him to Bethlehem when he went to anoint a king?
history.explain: The LORD told Samuel to take a heifer and say he came to sacrifice, 1 Samuel 16:2.

history.q: In the wilderness of which place did David cut off Saul's robe in a cave?
history.explain: Saul went into a cave in the wilderness of En Gedi, 1 Samuel 24:1-4.

history.q: Which servant of Saul's household told David that Jonathan's son was still alive?
history.explain: Ziba told David about Jonathan's crippled son, 2 Samuel 9:2-3.

history.q: From whom did David buy the threshing floor to build an altar, refusing to offer a free sacrifice?
history.explain: David refused a free gift and bought the threshing floor from Araunah, 2 Samuel 24:18-24.

history.q: Adonijah declared himself king with the backing of Joab and which priest?
history.explain: Adonijah conferred with Joab and Abiathar the priest, who helped him, 1 Kings 1:7.

history.q: The large bronze basin called the Sea in Solomon's temple stood on the backs of how many bronze oxen?
history.explain: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, 1 Kings 7:25.

history.q: The town of Zarephath, where Elijah stayed with the widow, belonged to which city's territory?
history.explain: The LORD sent Elijah to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, 1 Kings 17:9.

history.q: When Elijah said he alone was left, how many people did the LORD say had not bowed to Baal?
history.explain: The LORD said He had left seven thousand in Israel who had not bowed to Baal, 1 Kings 19:18.

history.q: To which city did Elisha lead the blinded Syrian army?
history.explain: Elisha led them to Samaria, where their eyes were opened, 2 Kings 6:19-20.

history.q: What did Hezekiah break to pieces because Israel had burned incense to it?
history.a: The bronze serpent Moses had made
options: The bronze serpent Moses had made
history.explain: Hezekiah broke the bronze serpent, which was called Nehushtan, 2 Kings 18:4.

history.q: Which item did Achan take from Jericho along with silver and a bar of gold?
history.explain: Achan confessed he saw a beautiful robe from Shinar, 200 shekels of silver, and a bar of gold, Joshua 7:21.

history.q: What mistake did Israel's leaders make before agreeing to the treaty with the Gibeonites?
history.a: They did not ask the LORD for counsel
options: They did not count the Gibeonites' weapons
They did not ask for hostages
They did not send spies to Gibeon
They did not ask the LORD for counsel
history.explain: The men sampled the food but did not ask counsel from the LORD, Joshua 9:14.

history.q: Which judge delivered Israel from King Cushan-rishathaim of Aram Naharaim?
history.explain: The LORD raised up Othniel son of Kenaz, who defeated Cushan-rishathaim, Judges 3:8-10.

history.q: Which brother of Joab went down into Saul's camp at night with David?
history.explain: David went into Saul's camp at night with Abishai, 1 Samuel 26:6-7.

history.q: How many golden lampstands did Solomon make for the temple?
history.explain: He made ten lampstands of pure gold, five on the right and five on the left, 1 Kings 7:49.

history.q: Who told the king that Haman had built a gallows at his house for Mordecai?
history.explain: Harbonah, one of the eunuchs, told the king about the gallows, Esther 7:9.

history.q: On the sun dial of which king did the shadow go back ten steps for Hezekiah?
history.explain: The shadow went back on the sun dial of Ahaz, 2 Kings 20:11.

history.q: To which city was King Manasseh taken captive in chains before he humbled himself?
history.explain: Manasseh was bound with fetters and carried to Babylon, 2 Chronicles 33:11.

history.q: Which royal scribe read the newly found Book of the Law aloud to King Josiah?
history.explain: Shaphan the scribe read the book before the king, 2 Kings 22:10.

history.q: Why was Ezra ashamed to ask the king for soldiers to protect the exiles on the journey?
history.a: He had told the king God's hand is for good on all who seek Him
options: He feared the king would refuse him
He did not trust the king's soldiers
He thought the road was safe
He had told the king God's hand is for good on all who seek Him
history.explain: Ezra had said to the king that God's hand is good on all who seek Him, Ezra 8:22.

wisdom.q: The LORD is my ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:1 begins, 'The LORD is my shepherd.'

wisdom.q: Thy word is a lamp unto my ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 119:105 says God's word is a lamp unto my feet.

wisdom.q: Trust in the LORD with all thine ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 3:5 says to trust in the LORD with all your heart.

wisdom.q: God is our refuge and ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 46:1 says God is our refuge and strength.

wisdom.q: Be still, and know that I am ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 46:10 says, 'Be still, and know that I am God.'

wisdom.q: This is the day the LORD has made; we will ___ and be glad in it.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 118:24 says we will rejoice and be glad in it.

wisdom.q: A soft (gentle) answer turns away ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 15:1 says a soft answer turns away wrath.

wisdom.q: Which shepherd boy who became king wrote most of the Psalms?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 3:1 is titled 'A Psalm of David,' and many Psalms carry his name.

wisdom.q: Which wise king wrote many of the Proverbs?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 1:1 says 'The proverbs of Solomon the son of David.'

wisdom.q: Which patient man trusted God even after losing so much?
wisdom.explain: In Job 1:21 Job said, 'Blessed be the name of the LORD.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 23, what does the LORD make me do in green pastures?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:2 says He makes me lie down in green pastures.

wisdom.q: In Psalm 23, the LORD leads me beside what kind of waters?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:2 says He leads me beside the still waters.

wisdom.q: Train up a child in the way he should ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 22:6 says to train up a child in the way he should go.

wisdom.q: A merry heart does good like a ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 17:22 says a merry heart does good like a medicine.

wisdom.q: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:4 says, 'I will fear no evil: for thou art with me.'

wisdom.q: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not ___ against thee.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 119:11 says the word is hidden in the heart so that I might not sin against God.

wisdom.q: Create in me a clean heart, O ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 51:10 says, 'Create in me a clean heart, O God.'

wisdom.q: Delight thyself also in the LORD, and he shall give thee the desires of thine ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 37:4 promises the desires of your heart to those who delight in the LORD.

wisdom.q: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 16:18 warns that a haughty spirit comes before a fall.

wisdom.q: To every thing there is a ___, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 3:1 says to every thing there is a season.

wisdom.q: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy ___.
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 12:1 urges us to remember our Creator in the days of our youth.

wisdom.q: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 27:17 says a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.

wisdom.q: Which man was one of the three friends who came to comfort Job?
wisdom.explain: Job 2:11 names Eliphaz, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar as Job's three friends.

wisdom.q: In what land did Job live?
wisdom.explain: Job 1:1 says there was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job.

wisdom.q: How many sons did Job have at the beginning of the story?
wisdom.explain: Job 1:2 says seven sons and three daughters were born to him.

wisdom.q: Which Psalm is the shortest chapter in the Bible?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 117 has only two verses, starting at Psalm 117:1.

wisdom.q: Which Psalm is the longest chapter in the Bible?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 119 runs to 176 verses, ending at Psalm 119:176.

wisdom.q: In which book do we read, 'To every thing there is a season'?
wisdom.explain: The famous 'season' passage opens Ecclesiastes 3:1.

wisdom.q: Which book of poetry comes right after Job in the Bible?
wisdom.explain: Psalms follows Job, beginning at Psalm 1:1.

wisdom.q: A good name is rather to be chosen than great ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 22:1 says a good name is rather to be chosen than great riches.

wisdom.q: The LORD is my light and my ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 27:1 begins, 'The LORD is my light and my salvation.'

wisdom.q: In Job 19:25, Job declares that who lives?
wisdom.explain: Job 19:25 says, 'I know that my Redeemer lives.'

wisdom.q: When the LORD restored Job, how much did He give him compared to what he had before?
wisdom.explain: Job 42:10 says the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

wisdom.q: Out of what did the LORD answer Job?
wisdom.explain: Job 38:1 says the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind.

wisdom.q: Which book contains the saying 'Vanity of vanities, all is vanity'?
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 1:2 opens with 'Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.'

wisdom.q: Who can find a virtuous ___? for her price is far above rubies.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 31:10 opens the praise of the virtuous woman.

wisdom.q: Who is named as the speaker of the words in Proverbs 30?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 30:1 names 'the words of Agur the son of Jakeh.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 2:1, which flower of the valleys is named alongside the rose of Sharon?
wisdom.explain: Song of Solomon 2:1 pairs the rose of Sharon with the lily of the valleys.

wisdom.q: By the rivers of what city did the exiles sit down and weep?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 137:1 says, 'By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down.'

wisdom.q: Which man of God is credited with the prayer in Psalm 90?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 90 is titled 'A Prayer of Moses the man of God.'

wisdom.q: Fear God, and keep his ___: for this is the whole duty of man.
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 12:13 says to fear God and keep his commandments.

wisdom.q: In Psalm 23, what does the LORD prepare before me in the presence of my enemies?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:5 says God prepares a table before me in the presence of my enemies.

wisdom.q: According to Psalm 23, where will I dwell forever?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:6 ends, 'I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 100 says to enter God's gates with what?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 100:4 says, 'Enter into his gates with thanksgiving.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 150 says let everything that has what praise the LORD?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 150:6 says, 'Let everything that has breath praise the LORD.'

wisdom.q: Which tiny creature does Proverbs tell a lazy person to learn from?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 6:6 says, 'Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider her ways and be wise.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 139:14, David praises God because he is what?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 139:14 says, 'I am fearfully and wonderfully made.'

wisdom.q: O taste and see that the LORD is ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 34:8 invites us to taste and see that the LORD is good.

wisdom.q: Psalm 91 says God gives His what charge over you, to keep you in all your ways?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 91:11 says God will give His angels charge over you.

wisdom.q: Psalm 19:1 says what declares the glory of God?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 19:1 says, 'The heavens declare the glory of God.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 1 compares the person who delights in God's law to what?
wisdom.a: a tree planted by streams of water
options: a tree planted by streams of water
wisdom.explain: Psalm 1:3 says he is like a tree planted by streams of water.

wisdom.q: Proverbs 18:10 says the name of the LORD is a strong what?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 18:10 says the name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

wisdom.q: Proverbs 10:1 says a wise son makes whom glad?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 10:1 says a wise son makes a glad father.

wisdom.q: In Psalm 121:1, where does the psalmist lift up his eyes?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 121:1 says, 'I will lift up my eyes to the hills.'

wisdom.q: Two are better than ___.
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 4:9 says two are better than one.

wisdom.q: Proverbs 17:17 says a friend loves at what times?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 17:17 says a friend loves at all times.

wisdom.q: Psalm 24:1 says the earth belongs to whom?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 24:1 says the earth is the LORD's and everything in it.

wisdom.q: Which prophet came to David before he prayed Psalm 51?
wisdom.explain: The title of Psalm 51 says it was written when Nathan the prophet came to David.

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 2:4, his banner over me was what?
wisdom.explain: Song of Solomon 2:4 says, 'His banner over me is love.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 1:1 says blessed is the one who does not walk in the counsel of whom?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 1:1 blesses the one who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked.

wisdom.q: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 1:7 says the fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge.

wisdom.q: Proverbs 27:1 warns us not to boast about what?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 27:1 says, 'Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 103:12 says God removes our sins as far as the east is from what?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 103:12 says, 'As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.'

wisdom.q: Which Psalm begins with the cry, 'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?'
wisdom.explain: Psalm 22:1 opens with this cry, which Jesus also spoke on the cross.

wisdom.q: How many Psalms are in the book of Psalms?
wisdom.explain: The book of Psalms ends with Psalm 150.

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 1:9 says there is nothing new under what?
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 1:9 says there is nothing new under the sun.

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 4:12 says a cord of how many strands is not quickly broken?
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 4:12 says a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

wisdom.q: What did Job use to scrape himself as he sat in the ashes?
wisdom.explain: Job 2:8 says Job took a potsherd (broken pottery) to scrape himself.

wisdom.q: Psalm 150 says to praise God with the sound of what?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 150:3 says, 'Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 25:21 says if your enemy is hungry, give him what to eat?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 25:21 says to give your hungry enemy bread to eat.

wisdom.q: Psalm 126:5 says those who sow in tears will reap in what?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 126:5 says, 'Those who sow in tears shall reap in joy.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 84:10 says a day in God's courts is better than how many elsewhere?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 84:10 says a day in your courts is better than a thousand.

wisdom.q: Song of Solomon 8:7 says many what cannot quench love?
wisdom.explain: Song of Solomon 8:7 says, 'Many waters cannot quench love.'

wisdom.q: How many camels did Job own before his trials began?
wisdom.explain: Job 1:3 lists 7,000 sheep, 3,000 camels, 500 yoke of oxen and 500 donkeys.

wisdom.q: After the LORD restored Job, how many sheep did he have?
wisdom.explain: Job 42:12 says Job came to have 14,000 sheep.

wisdom.q: Which was the name of one of Job's daughters after his restoration?
wisdom.explain: Job 42:14 names his daughters Jemimah, Keziah and Keren-happuch.

wisdom.q: In Job 38:4, God asks Job where he was when He did what?
wisdom.a: laid the foundations of the earth
options: laid the foundations of the earth
wisdom.explain: Job 38:4 asks, 'Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 1:1 identifies the author as the son of whom?
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 1:1 calls him the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

wisdom.q: Proverbs 25:1 says whose men copied out more of Solomon's proverbs?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 25:1 says the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied them out.

wisdom.q: Whose mother taught him the words recorded in Proverbs 31:1?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 31:1 records the words of King Lemuel, which his mother taught him.

wisdom.q: Psalm 90:4 says a thousand years in God's sight are like what?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 90:4 says a thousand years in God's sight are like yesterday when it passes.

wisdom.q: In Psalm 110:1, where does the LORD tell David's Lord to sit?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 110:1 says, 'Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies your footstool.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 119 is arranged in sections following the letters of what?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 119 is an acrostic with sections following the letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

wisdom.q: How many friends came to comfort Job in Job 2:11?
wisdom.explain: Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar were Job's three friends who came to sympathize with him.

wisdom.q: In Job 1:8, what does the LORD call Job?
wisdom.explain: The LORD asked Satan, 'Have you considered my servant Job?'

wisdom.q: How many daughters did Job have at the start of the story?
wisdom.explain: Job 1:2 says seven sons and three daughters were born to Job.

wisdom.q: In Psalm 23:5, what happens to my cup?
wisdom.explain: David says, 'my cup overflows.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 23:4, what two things comfort me?
wisdom.explain: 'Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 100:3 says we are His people and the sheep of His what?
wisdom.explain: 'We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 100:2 says to serve the LORD with what?
wisdom.explain: 'Serve the LORD with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 150:4 says to praise God with timbrel and what?
wisdom.explain: 'Praise him with timbrel and dance.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 18:21 says death and life are in the power of what?
wisdom.explain: 'Death and life are in the power of the tongue.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 16:24 says pleasant words are like a what?
wisdom.explain: 'Gracious words are like a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 14:1 says a wise woman does what to her house?
wisdom.explain: 'The wise woman builds her house, but the foolish tears it down with her hands.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 3:4 says there is a time to weep and a time to what?
wisdom.explain: 'A time to weep, and a time to laugh.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 3:7 says there is a time to keep silence and a time to what?
wisdom.explain: 'A time to keep silence, and a time to speak.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 3:8 says there is a time for war and a time for what?
wisdom.explain: 'A time for war, and a time for peace.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 2:11, what season is past?
wisdom.explain: 'For behold, the winter is past; the rain is over and gone.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 51:7, David asks to be washed whiter than what?
wisdom.explain: 'Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 24:7 says to lift up your what, O gates?
wisdom.explain: 'Lift up your heads, O gates! And be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 91:4 says God will cover you with His what?
wisdom.explain: 'He will cover you with his pinions (feathers), and under his wings you will find refuge.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 91:2 calls the LORD my refuge and my what?
wisdom.explain: 'He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 42:1, which animal longs for streams of water?
wisdom.explain: 'As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, O God.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 30:5 says weeping may last for the night, but joy comes in the what?
wisdom.explain: 'Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the morning.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 127:3 says children are a what from the LORD?
wisdom.explain: 'Behold, children are a heritage from the LORD.'

wisdom.q: Which younger man spoke after Job's three friends stopped answering him?
wisdom.explain: Elihu son of Barachel waited because the others were older, then spoke in Job 32-37.

wisdom.q: In Job 42:10, the LORD restored Job's fortunes when he did what?
wisdom.explain: 'The LORD restored the fortunes of Job, when he had prayed for his friends.'

wisdom.q: In Job 42:8, how many bulls and rams did the LORD tell Job's friends to offer?
wisdom.explain: The LORD told them to take seven bulls and seven rams for a burnt offering.

wisdom.q: What did Job's wife tell him to do in Job 2:9?
wisdom.explain: She said, 'Curse God and die.'

wisdom.q: In Job 38:7, who sang together when the earth's foundations were laid?
wisdom.explain: 'When the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy.'

wisdom.q: According to its heading, David wrote Psalm 51 after he went in to whom?
wisdom.explain: The heading says it was written when Nathan came to David after he had gone in to Bathsheba.

wisdom.q: According to its heading, Psalm 3 was written when David fled from which son?
wisdom.explain: The heading of Psalm 3: 'when he fled from Absalom his son.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 19:10 says God's rules are sweeter than what?
wisdom.explain: 'Sweeter also than honey and drippings of the honeycomb.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 139:13, God knit David together where?
wisdom.explain: 'You knitted me together in my mother's womb.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 1:4 compares the wicked to what?
wisdom.a: chaff that the wind drives away
options: chaff that the wind drives away
wisdom.explain: 'The wicked are not so, but are like chaff that the wind drives away.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 118:22 says the stone the builders rejected has become the what?
wisdom.explain: 'The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 133:1 says it is good and pleasant when brothers dwell together in what?
wisdom.explain: 'Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in unity!'

wisdom.q: Psalm 127 is attributed in its heading to which king?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 127 is headed 'A Song of Ascents. Of Solomon.'

wisdom.q: Which Levite musician is credited with Psalm 50?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 50 is headed 'A Psalm of Asaph.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 9:10 says the fear of the LORD is the beginning of what?
wisdom.explain: 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 4:7 says in all your getting, get what?
wisdom.explain: 'Though it cost all you have, get understanding.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 10:4 says the hand of the diligent does what?
wisdom.explain: 'The hand of the diligent makes rich.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 16:32 says one who is slow to anger is better than whom?
wisdom.explain: 'Whoever is slow to anger is better than the mighty.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 14:12 says a way that seems right leads to the way of what?
wisdom.explain: 'There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 24:16 says the righteous fall seven times and do what?
wisdom.explain: 'For the righteous falls seven times and rises again.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 28:1 says the righteous are bold as what?
wisdom.explain: 'The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are bold as a lion.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 3:11 says God has made everything what in its time?
wisdom.explain: 'He has made everything beautiful in its time.'

wisdom.q: Song of Solomon 2:15 names which small animals that spoil the vineyards?
wisdom.explain: 'Catch the foxes for us, the little foxes that spoil the vineyards.'

wisdom.q: Which of Job's three friends is called 'the Temanite'?
wisdom.explain: Job 2:11 names Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite.

wisdom.q: How many donkeys did Job own at the start (Job 1:3)?
wisdom.explain: Job owned 7,000 sheep, 3,000 camels, 500 yoke of oxen and 500 female donkeys.

wisdom.q: In Job 41, which sea creature does God ask Job if he can draw out with a fishhook?
wisdom.explain: 'Can you draw out Leviathan with a fishhook?'

wisdom.q: According to its heading, Psalm 88 is a psalm of which man?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 88 is headed 'A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.'

wisdom.q: How many psalms are titled 'A Song of Ascents' (Psalms 120-134)?
wisdom.explain: Psalms 120 through 134 each carry the heading 'A Song of Ascents', totaling fifteen.

wisdom.q: According to 1 Kings 4:32, how many proverbs did Solomon speak?
wisdom.explain: 'He spoke 3,000 proverbs, and his songs were 1,005.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 11:1 says to cast your bread upon what?
wisdom.explain: 'Cast your bread upon the waters, for you will find it after many days.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 6:16 says there are six things the LORD hates; how many are an abomination to Him?
wisdom.explain: 'There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are an abomination to him.'

wisdom.q: Song of Solomon 8:6 says love is strong as what?
wisdom.explain: 'For love is strong as death, jealousy is fierce as the grave.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 25:11 compares a word fitly spoken to apples of gold in settings of what?
wisdom.explain: 'A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in a setting of silver.'

wisdom.q: According to its heading, Psalm 34 was written when David changed his behavior before which king?
wisdom.explain: The heading names Abimelech (Achish of Gath), before whom David pretended madness.

wisdom.q: By what other name is Song of Solomon known, from its opening line?
wisdom.explain: Song of Solomon 1:1 begins, 'The Song of Songs, which is Solomon's.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 8:1 says, 'O LORD our Lord, how excellent is your name in all the ___!'
wisdom.explain: 'O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!'

wisdom.q: Psalm 27:14 says to wait on the LORD and be of good what?
wisdom.explain: 'Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 46:2 says we will not fear though the mountains are carried into the middle of the what?
wisdom.explain: '...though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 95:1 says to make a joyful noise to the what of our salvation?
wisdom.explain: '...let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 95:6 says, 'Let us kneel before the LORD our ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 103:1 says, 'Bless the LORD, O my ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 103:2 says, 'Forget not all his ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 103:5, our youth is renewed like whose?
wisdom.explain: '...so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 121:4 says the One who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor do what?
wisdom.explain: 'Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 121:2 says my help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and what?
wisdom.explain: 'My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 136, each verse says the LORD's mercy endures for how long?
wisdom.explain: 'O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 145:18 says the LORD is ___ to all who call upon Him.
wisdom.explain: 'The LORD is nigh (near) unto all them that call upon him.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 148:3 says to praise Him, sun and what?
wisdom.explain: 'Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 148:12 says young men and maidens, old men and what, should praise the LORD?
wisdom.explain: 'Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children: let them praise the name of the LORD.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 55:22 says, 'Cast your ___ upon the LORD, and He will sustain you.'
wisdom.explain: 'Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 19:14 calls the LORD 'my strength, and my ___.'
wisdom.explain: '...O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 18:24 says there is a friend who sticks closer than a what?
wisdom.explain: '...there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.'

wisdom.q: In Proverbs 6:9, the wise writer asks the lazy person, 'How long will you ___?'
wisdom.explain: 'How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard?'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 12:22 says lying lips are an abomination to whom?
wisdom.explain: 'Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 13:20 says that one who walks with the wise will become what?
wisdom.explain: 'He that walketh with wise men shall be wise.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 1:8 says not to forsake the law of your what?
wisdom.explain: 'My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 3:9 says to honor the LORD with the what of all your increase?
wisdom.explain: 'Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 3:7 says, 'Be not wise in your own ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 3:4 says there is a time to mourn and a time to what?
wisdom.explain: 'A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 12:12 says that of making many what there is no end?
wisdom.explain: '...of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.'

wisdom.q: When Job lost everything, he fell to the ground and did what (Job 1:20)?
wisdom.explain: 'Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped.'

wisdom.q: Job 1:21 says, 'The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away; blessed be the ___ of the LORD.'
wisdom.explain: 'The LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 2:3, the beloved is compared to which tree among the trees of the wood?
wisdom.explain: 'As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 2:12, the voice of which bird is heard in the land?
wisdom.explain: 'The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 22:18 says they divide my garments and cast what for my clothing?
wisdom.explain: 'They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 27:10 says that when my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will do what?
wisdom.explain: 'When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 46:9 says God burns what in the fire?
wisdom.explain: 'He maketh wars to cease...he burneth the chariot in the fire.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 103:13 says God pities those who fear Him like whom?
wisdom.explain: 'Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.'

wisdom.q: Which sea does Psalm 136:13 say God divided into parts?
wisdom.explain: 'To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 8:2 says God has ordained strength out of the mouths of whom?
wisdom.explain: 'Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength.' Jesus quotes this in Matthew 21:16.

wisdom.q: In Psalm 2:4, what does the One enthroned in heaven do at the plotting kings of the earth?
wisdom.explain: 'He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 20:7 says some trust in chariots and some in what?
wisdom.explain: 'Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 22:7 says the borrower is servant to whom?
wisdom.explain: 'The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 23:5 says riches make themselves wings and fly away like what?
wisdom.explain: 'For riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.'

wisdom.q: According to Proverbs 19:17, whoever is kind to the poor lends to whom?
wisdom.explain: 'He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 26:14 says the lazy person turns on his bed like a door on its what?
wisdom.explain: 'As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 27:10 says better is a neighbor who is near than a brother who is what?
wisdom.explain: '...better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 26:11 says a fool returns to his folly like a dog returns to its what?
wisdom.explain: 'As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.'

wisdom.q: In Proverbs 9:1, how many pillars did Wisdom hew out for her house?
wisdom.explain: 'Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 11:1 says a false balance is an abomination, but a just weight is the LORD's what?
wisdom.explain: 'A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 29:15 says a child left to himself brings his mother to what?
wisdom.explain: 'The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 9:11 says the race is not to the what?
wisdom.explain: 'The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 5:2 says, 'God is in heaven, and you are on ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 9:4 says a living dog is better than a dead what?
wisdom.explain: '...for a living dog is better than a dead lion.'

wisdom.q: In Job 42:11, each friend gave Job a piece of money and a ring of what?
wisdom.explain: After Job's restoration, 'every one an earring of gold.'

wisdom.q: In Job 42:6, Job repents in dust and what?
wisdom.explain: 'Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.'

wisdom.q: In Job 29:15, Job says 'I was eyes to the blind and ___ to the lame.'
wisdom.explain: 'I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.'

wisdom.q: In Job 38:41, God asks who provides food for which bird when its young cry out?
wisdom.explain: 'Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 2:9, my beloved is like a roe or a young what?
wisdom.explain: 'My beloved is like a roe or a young hart.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 5:10, my beloved is the chief among how many?
wisdom.explain: 'My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 8:6, the bride asks to be set as a what upon the heart?
wisdom.explain: 'Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 110:4 says the LORD swore that the Messiah is a priest forever after the order of whom?
wisdom.explain: 'Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.' See Hebrews 5-7.

wisdom.q: Psalm 136:20 names Og as king of what land?
wisdom.explain: 'And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 37:25, David says he has never seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging what?
wisdom.explain: 'I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 30:26 says the rock badgers (conies) make their houses in the what?
wisdom.explain: 'The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 21:1 says the king's heart in the LORD's hand is like what?
wisdom.explain: 'The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.'

wisdom.q: In Proverbs 30:8, Agur prays, 'Give me neither poverty nor ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'Give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 16:33 says the lot is cast into the what?
wisdom.explain: 'The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 7:20 says there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and never does what?
wisdom.explain: 'For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.'

wisdom.q: In Ecclesiastes 12:6, which cord is loosed before the golden bowl is broken?
wisdom.explain: 'Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken.' A poetic picture of old age and death.

wisdom.q: In Job 31:1, with what did Job make a covenant?
wisdom.explain: 'I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?'

wisdom.q: In Job 14:7, Job says there is hope for what, that if it is cut down it will sprout again?
wisdom.explain: 'For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again.'

wisdom.q: In Job 1:17, which people raided Job's camels?
wisdom.explain: 'The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 1:5, the bride says she is dark but lovely like the tents of which place?
wisdom.explain: 'I am black, but comely...as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 4:12, the bride is called a garden enclosed, a spring shut up, and a fountain what?
wisdom.explain: 'A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 23:3 says the LORD restores my what?
wisdom.explain: 'He restoreth my soul.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 23:5, You anoint my head with what?
wisdom.explain: 'Thou anointest my head with oil.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 23:3 says the LORD leads me in the paths of what?
wisdom.explain: 'He leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 3:3 says the LORD is a what around me?
wisdom.explain: 'But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 5:3 says the LORD hears my voice in the what?
wisdom.explain: 'My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 32:7 says the LORD is my what?
wisdom.explain: 'Thou art my hiding place.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 40:2 says God set David's feet upon a what?
wisdom.explain: God brought David up out of the pit and set his feet upon a rock.

wisdom.q: Psalm 63:7 says David sings for joy in the shadow of God's what?
wisdom.explain: 'In the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 98:1 says to sing to the LORD what kind of song?
wisdom.explain: 'O sing unto the LORD a new song.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 126:2 says our mouths were filled with what?
wisdom.explain: 'Then was our mouth filled with laughter.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 119:130 says the entrance of God's words gives what?
wisdom.explain: 'The entrance of thy words giveth light.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 30:11 says God turned my mourning into what?
wisdom.explain: 'Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 92:12 says the righteous will flourish like which tree?
wisdom.explain: 'The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 8:11 says wisdom is better than what?
wisdom.explain: 'For wisdom is better than rubies.'

wisdom.q: In Proverbs 31, who rise up and call the noble wife blessed?
wisdom.explain: 'Her children arise up, and call her blessed.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 31:21 says the noble wife is not afraid of what for her household?
wisdom.explain: 'She is not afraid of the snow for her household.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 20:12 says the LORD made both the hearing ear and the what?
wisdom.explain: 'The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 30:27 says which insects have no king, yet march out in ranks?
wisdom.explain: 'The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 4:10 says if one falls, the other will do what?
wisdom.explain: 'If they fall, the one will lift up his fellow.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 3:2 says there is a time to be born and a time to what?
wisdom.explain: 'A time to be born, and a time to die.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 1:7 says all the rivers run into the what?
wisdom.explain: 'All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 9:10 says whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your what?
wisdom.explain: 'Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 133:2 says the precious oil ran down upon the beard of whom?
wisdom.explain: Unity is like precious oil running down on Aaron's beard.

wisdom.q: Psalm 146:3 says not to put your trust in whom?
wisdom.explain: 'Put not your trust in princes.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 40:1, what did David do for the LORD?
wisdom.explain: 'I waited patiently for the LORD.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 32:8, God says He will counsel you with His what upon you?
wisdom.explain: 'I will guide thee with mine eye.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 73:26, God is the strength of my heart and my what forever?
wisdom.explain: 'God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 90:10 says the days of our years are how many (and by strength, eighty)?
wisdom.explain: 'The days of our years are threescore years and ten.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 92 is titled a song for which day?
options: the first day of the month
wisdom.explain: Psalm 92's heading: 'A Song for the sabbath day.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 116:13, the psalmist will take up the cup of what?
wisdom.explain: 'I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 130:1 says, 'Out of the what have I cried to you, O LORD'?
wisdom.explain: 'Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 126:1, when the LORD restored Zion, the people were like those who do what?
wisdom.explain: 'We were like them that dream.'

wisdom.q: Into how many 'books' are the Psalms traditionally divided (each ending with a doxology, as at Psalm 41:13)?
wisdom.explain: The Psalms are traditionally divided into five books.

wisdom.q: Psalm 13 begins 'How long, O LORD?' What kind of psalm is it?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 13 is a psalm of lament, a cry for help that ends in trust.

wisdom.q: Proverbs 31:30 says which kind of woman shall be praised?
wisdom.explain: 'A woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 12:4 says a virtuous wife is a what to her husband?
wisdom.explain: 'A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 16:9 says that while a man plans his way, who directs his steps?
wisdom.explain: 'The LORD directeth his steps.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 22:29 says a man diligent in his work will stand before whom?
wisdom.explain: 'He shall stand before kings.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 16:12 says a king's throne is established by what?
wisdom.explain: 'The throne is established by righteousness.'

wisdom.q: In Job 40:15, the beast Behemoth eats grass like what animal?
wisdom.explain: 'He eateth grass as an ox.'

wisdom.q: In Job 38:22, God asks Job if he has entered the storehouses of what?
wisdom.explain: 'Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow?'

wisdom.q: In Job 38:8, God asks who shut up the sea with what?
wisdom.explain: 'Who shut up the sea with doors?'

wisdom.q: In Job 39:25, which animal says among the trumpets, 'Aha!'?
wisdom.explain: The warhorse of Job 39 says 'Ha, ha' among the trumpets.

wisdom.q: In Job 40:4, Job puts his hand upon what, after God questions him?
wisdom.explain: 'I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.'

wisdom.q: In Job 1:9, who asks, 'Does Job fear God for nothing?'
wisdom.explain: Satan challenged Job's motives before the LORD.

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 6:3, 'I am my beloved's, and my beloved is ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 73:3, Asaph says he was envious when he saw the prosperity of whom?
wisdom.explain: Asaph envied the prosperity of the wicked.

wisdom.q: Psalm 138:6 says that though the LORD is high, He regards the what?
wisdom.explain: 'Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 133:3, unity is compared to the dew of which mountain?
wisdom.explain: 'As the dew of Hermon.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 119:1-8, the first section, is headed by which Hebrew letter?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 119 is an acrostic; its first eight verses each begin with Aleph.

wisdom.q: Psalms 146 through 150 each begin and end with what call?
wisdom.explain: The last five Psalms each open and close with 'Hallelujah' (Praise the LORD).

wisdom.q: Psalm 72:20 says the prayers of which man, son of Jesse, are ended?
wisdom.explain: 'The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.'

wisdom.q: The poem of the noble wife in Proverbs 31:10-31 is arranged following the letters of what?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 31:10-31 is an acrostic poem in Hebrew alphabetical order.

wisdom.q: Proverbs 25:2 says it is the glory of kings to do what?
wisdom.explain: 'The honour of kings is to search out a matter.'

wisdom.q: In Job 38:31, God asks if Job can bind the chains of which star cluster?
wisdom.explain: Job 38:31 mentions the Pleiades.

wisdom.q: In Job 42:5, Job says, 'Now my what sees you'?
wisdom.explain: 'Now mine eye seeth thee.'

wisdom.q: In Job 42:15, Job gave his daughters an inheritance among whom?
wisdom.explain: 'Their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.'

wisdom.q: How many years did Job live after his restoration, according to Job 42:16?
wisdom.explain: 'After this lived Job an hundred and forty years.'

wisdom.q: In Ecclesiastes 12:7, the spirit returns to whom?
wisdom.explain: 'The spirit shall return unto God who gave it.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 5:10 says he who loves what will not be satisfied with it?
wisdom.explain: 'He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 16:11 says that in God's presence there is fullness of what?
wisdom.explain: 'In thy presence is fulness of joy.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 34:1 says God's praise shall continually be in my what?
wisdom.explain: 'His praise shall continually be in my mouth.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 100:1 says, 'Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all you ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 118:6 says, 'The LORD is on my ___; I will not fear.'
wisdom.explain: 'The LORD is on my side; I will not fear.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 147:4, God counts the number of what and calls them all by name?
wisdom.explain: 'He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 127:2 says God gives His beloved what?
wisdom.explain: 'So he giveth his beloved sleep.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 131:2, David calms his soul like a weaned child with whom?
wisdom.explain: 'Like a weaned child with his mother.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 18:29, David says that by his God he can leap over a what?
wisdom.explain: 'By my God have I leaped over a wall.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 68:5 calls God a father to whom?
wisdom.explain: 'A father of the fatherless.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 84:3, which small bird finds a home near God's altars?
wisdom.explain: 'The sparrow hath found an house.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 86:5 says the Lord is good and ready to what?
wisdom.explain: 'Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 4:8, David lies down in what and sleeps?
wisdom.explain: 'I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 121:6 says the sun will not strike you by day, nor the what by night?
wisdom.explain: 'The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 9:1 says, 'I will praise you, O LORD, with my whole ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 11:2 says when pride comes, then comes what?
wisdom.explain: 'When pride cometh, then cometh shame.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 6:10 says 'a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'A little folding of the hands to sleep.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 2:13, which tree puts forth her green figs?
wisdom.explain: 'The fig tree putteth forth her green figs.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 1:15, the beloved's eyes are compared to which bird?
wisdom.explain: 'Thou hast doves' eyes.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 25:4 says, 'Show me your ways, O LORD; teach me your ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 25:7, David asks God not to remember the sins of his what?
wisdom.explain: 'Remember not the sins of my youth.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 66:12, God's people went through fire and through what?
wisdom.explain: 'We went through fire and through water.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 84:11 says the LORD God is a sun and a what?
wisdom.explain: 'The LORD God is a sun and shield.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 103:8 says the LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to what?
wisdom.explain: 'The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 103:3 says the LORD heals all your what?
wisdom.explain: 'Who healeth all thy diseases.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 115:4 says the idols of the nations are made of silver and what?
wisdom.explain: 'Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 119:89 says the LORD's word is settled where?
wisdom.explain: 'For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 127:4 compares children to what in the hand of a warrior?
wisdom.explain: 'As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 143:10, David prays, 'Teach me to do your ___.'
wisdom.explain: 'Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 42:5, the psalmist tells his downcast soul to do what?
wisdom.explain: 'Why art thou cast down, O my soul? ... hope thou in God.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 34:18 says the LORD is near to whom?
wisdom.explain: 'The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 13:12 says hope deferred makes the heart what?
wisdom.explain: 'Hope deferred maketh the heart sick.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 14:34 says righteousness exalts a what?
wisdom.explain: 'Righteousness exalteth a nation.'

wisdom.q: Ecclesiastes 3:3 says there is a time to break down and a time to what?
wisdom.explain: 'A time to break down, and a time to build up.'

wisdom.q: In Job 1:5, what did Job offer for his children after their feasts, in case they had sinned?
wisdom.explain: 'He rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all.'

wisdom.q: In Job 1:19, what struck the four corners of the house where Job's children were eating?
wisdom.explain: 'There came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house.'

wisdom.q: How long did Job's three friends sit on the ground with him without speaking (Job 2:13)?
wisdom.explain: 'So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights.'

wisdom.q: According to its heading, Psalm 18 was sung when the LORD delivered David from all his enemies and from the hand of whom?
wisdom.explain: The heading says David spoke this song when the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

wisdom.q: In Psalm 119:71, the psalmist says it is good for him that he has been what?
wisdom.explain: 'It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.'

wisdom.q: Psalm 68:6 says God sets the lonely in what?
wisdom.explain: 'God setteth the solitary in families.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 29:25 says the fear of man brings a what?
wisdom.explain: 'The fear of man bringeth a snare.'

wisdom.q: Proverbs 19:21 says that, though many plans are in a man's heart, whose counsel will stand?
wisdom.explain: 'The counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.'

wisdom.q: In Job 1:15, which people took Job's oxen and donkeys and killed his servants?
wisdom.explain: 'The Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away.'

wisdom.q: In Job 5:7, Eliphaz says man is born to trouble as sparks fly where?
wisdom.explain: 'Man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.'

wisdom.q: In Job 42:7, the LORD says His anger burns against which friend of Job?
wisdom.explain: 'My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends.'

wisdom.q: Which was the name of Job's second daughter after his restoration (Job 42:14)?
wisdom.explain: Job named his daughters Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren-happuch.

wisdom.q: In Ecclesiastes 12:5, which tree blossoms in the picture of old age?
wisdom.explain: 'The almond tree shall flourish.'

majorprophets.q: Who was thrown into the den of lions for praying to God?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel kept praying to God and was put in the lions' den (Daniel 6).

majorprophets.q: Who shut the lions' mouths so they could not hurt Daniel?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel said God sent His angel and shut the lions' mouths (Daniel 6:22).

majorprophets.q: Who was the king who loved Daniel and hoped God would save him from the lions?
majorprophets.explain: King Darius told Daniel that his God would deliver him (Daniel 6:16).

majorprophets.q: What did Daniel do three times every day, even when it was against the law?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel knelt and prayed three times a day (Daniel 6:10).

majorprophets.q: What did Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego refuse to bow down to?
majorprophets.explain: They would only worship God, not the golden image (Daniel 3).

majorprophets.q: Where were Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego thrown, and God kept them safe?
majorprophets.explain: God kept them safe in the fiery furnace; they were not burned (Daniel 3).

majorprophets.q: Which king set up the big golden statue?
majorprophets.explain: King Nebuchadnezzar made the image of gold (Daniel 3:1).

majorprophets.q: How many friends of Daniel were put in the fiery furnace?
majorprophets.explain: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, three friends, were in the furnace (Daniel 3).

majorprophets.q: What did Daniel and his friends ask to eat instead of the king's rich food?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel asked for vegetables and water, and they grew healthy (Daniel 1:12-15).

majorprophets.q: In Daniel 5, what appeared and wrote words on the palace wall?
majorprophets.explain: Fingers of a man's hand wrote on the wall (Daniel 5:5).

majorprophets.q: Which book of the Bible tells the story of Daniel in the lions' den?
majorprophets.explain: The lions' den story is in Daniel chapter 6.

majorprophets.q: Finish the verse: "For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is ___."
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 9:6 says unto us a son is given.

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah 40:31, those who wait on the Lord will rise up like which bird?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 40:31 promises those who wait on the Lord will rise up like eagles.

majorprophets.q: One name for Jesus in Isaiah 9:6 is "Prince of ___."
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 9:6 calls Him the Prince of Peace.

majorprophets.q: Finish the verse: "The wolf will live with the ___."
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 11:6 describes peace where the wolf lives with the lamb.

majorprophets.q: Finish the verse: "His mercies are new every ___."
majorprophets.explain: Lamentations 3:23 says God's mercies are new every morning.

majorprophets.q: Which prophet answered God, "Here am I; send me"?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah said "Here am I; send me" in Isaiah 6:8.

majorprophets.q: Which book contains the Suffering Servant passage that says "by his stripes we are healed"?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 53:5 speaks of the Servant wounded for our transgressions.

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah 7:14, what name is given to the child born of a virgin?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 7:14 names the child Immanuel, meaning God with us.

majorprophets.q: What were the heavenly creatures with six wings in Isaiah's vision of the temple called?
majorprophets.explain: Seraphim stood above the Lord, each with six wings (Isaiah 6:2).

majorprophets.q: To the exiles in which city did Jeremiah send the letter containing "plans to give you hope and a future"?
majorprophets.explain: Jeremiah wrote to the exiles in Babylon (Jeremiah 29).

majorprophets.q: Who was Jeremiah's scribe who wrote down his words on a scroll?
majorprophets.explain: Baruch wrote Jeremiah's words on a scroll (Jeremiah 36:4).

majorprophets.q: Who rescued Jeremiah from the muddy cistern?
majorprophets.explain: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian pulled Jeremiah out with ropes (Jeremiah 38).

majorprophets.q: Whom did God have Jeremiah go watch at work to learn about being shaped by God?
majorprophets.explain: God sent Jeremiah to the potter's house (Jeremiah 18).

majorprophets.q: What filled the valley in Ezekiel's famous vision that God brought back to life?
majorprophets.explain: Ezekiel saw a valley full of dry bones come to life (Ezekiel 37).

majorprophets.q: What role did God give Ezekiel for the house of Israel?
majorprophets.explain: God made Ezekiel a watchman for Israel (Ezekiel 3:17).

majorprophets.q: Whose dream of a statue with a head of gold did Daniel explain?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel interpreted Nebuchadnezzar's dream of the statue (Daniel 2).

majorprophets.q: In Nebuchadnezzar's dream, what was the statue's head made of?
majorprophets.explain: The head of the statue was fine gold (Daniel 2:32).

majorprophets.q: Which king was feasting when the hand wrote on the wall?
majorprophets.explain: King Belshazzar held the feast when the writing appeared (Daniel 5).

majorprophets.q: What Babylonian name was given to Daniel?
majorprophets.explain: The chief official renamed Daniel Belteshazzar (Daniel 1:7).

majorprophets.q: What Babylonian name was given to Hananiah?
majorprophets.explain: Hananiah was renamed Shadrach (Daniel 1:7).

majorprophets.q: Which city's fall and destruction does the book of Lamentations mourn?
majorprophets.explain: Lamentations grieves over the ruined Jerusalem (Lamentations 1).

majorprophets.q: By which river was Ezekiel among the exiles when he saw visions of God?
majorprophets.explain: Ezekiel was by the river Chebar (Ezekiel 1:1).

majorprophets.q: Which Persian king does Isaiah name as the Lord's anointed, long before he was born?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 45:1 calls Cyrus the Lord's anointed.

majorprophets.q: Which Assyrian king sent his commander to threaten Jerusalem in King Hezekiah's days?
majorprophets.explain: Sennacherib king of Assyria came against Judah's cities (Isaiah 36:1).

majorprophets.q: In the year which king died did Isaiah see the Lord seated on a throne?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah's vision came in the year King Uzziah died (Isaiah 6:1).

majorprophets.q: What was the hometown of Jeremiah, a priest's son?
majorprophets.explain: Jeremiah was of the priests in Anathoth (Jeremiah 1:1).

majorprophets.q: How many years did Jeremiah say Judah would serve Babylon before the Lord visited them?
majorprophets.explain: Jeremiah 29:10 speaks of seventy years for Babylon.

majorprophets.q: Which angel came to Daniel in swift flight at the time of the evening offering to give him understanding?
majorprophets.explain: Gabriel came to Daniel to give him insight (Daniel 9:21-22).

majorprophets.q: In Ezekiel's vision of the life-giving river, from where did the water flow?
majorprophets.explain: Water flowed out from under the threshold of the temple (Ezekiel 47:1).

majorprophets.q: Finish the verse: "Great is your ___." (Lamentations 3)
majorprophets.explain: Lamentations 3:23 says great is your faithfulness.

majorprophets.q: Which book comes right after Lamentations in the Bible?
majorprophets.explain: Ezekiel follows Lamentations, and Daniel follows Ezekiel.

majorprophets.q: How many men did King Nebuchadnezzar see walking in the fire after three were thrown in?
majorprophets.explain: He saw four men loose and walking in the fire, and God kept them safe (Daniel 3:24-25).

majorprophets.q: After the furnace, the three friends' hair was not singed and they did not smell of what?
majorprophets.explain: Not even the smell of fire was on them (Daniel 3:27).

majorprophets.q: What happened to King Darius that night while Daniel was in the lions' den?
majorprophets.explain: The king fasted and sleep fled from him (Daniel 6:18).

majorprophets.q: Along with vegetables, what did Daniel and his friends ask to drink?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel asked for vegetables to eat and water to drink (Daniel 1:12).

majorprophets.q: Toward which city did Daniel's windows open when he prayed?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel prayed at his open windows toward Jerusalem (Daniel 6:10).

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah's picture of peace, who will lead the wolf, the lamb and the lion?
majorprophets.explain: A little child shall lead them (Isaiah 11:6).

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah's picture of peace, what will the lion eat?
majorprophets.explain: The lion will eat straw like the ox (Isaiah 11:7).

majorprophets.q: According to Isaiah 40:8, what stands forever?
majorprophets.explain: The grass withers and the flower fades, but God's word stands forever (Isaiah 40:8).

majorprophets.q: What did God cause to enter the dry bones in Ezekiel's vision so they lived?
majorprophets.explain: God put breath in the bones and they lived (Ezekiel 37:5-10).

majorprophets.q: Why did Jeremiah say he could not speak for God?
majorprophets.explain: Jeremiah said he did not know how to speak because he was only a youth (Jeremiah 1:6).

majorprophets.q: Why was Daniel not hurt by the lions?
majorprophets.explain: No harm was found on Daniel because he trusted in his God (Daniel 6:23).

majorprophets.q: Who showed Daniel the secret of the king's dream?
majorprophets.explain: The secret was revealed to Daniel in a night vision from God (Daniel 2:19).

majorprophets.q: What happened to King Belshazzar's knees when he saw the hand writing on the wall?
majorprophets.explain: His knees knocked together in fear (Daniel 5:6).

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah 53:6, we have all gone astray like what animals?
majorprophets.explain: All we like sheep have gone astray (Isaiah 53:6).

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah 1:18, God says sins like scarlet can become white as what?
majorprophets.explain: Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow (Isaiah 1:18).

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah 55:12, what do the trees of the field do?
majorprophets.explain: All the trees of the field shall clap their hands (Isaiah 55:12).

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah's vision, what did a seraph touch to Isaiah's lips?
majorprophets.explain: A burning coal from the altar touched his lips and his sin was taken away (Isaiah 6:6-7).

majorprophets.q: According to Jeremiah 1:5, what had God done with Jeremiah before he was born?
