paul.explain: Paul lists nine: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

paul.q: Whose schemes can we stand against by putting on God's armour?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:11 says to put on God's armour to stand against the devil's schemes.

paul.q: Which Bible chapter is often called the love chapter?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13 describes what love is and does.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 13:8, what does love never do?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:8 says love never fails.

paul.q: Instead of worrying, what does Philippians 4:6 tell us to do with everything?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:6 says do not be anxious, but bring everything to God in prayer with thanksgiving.

paul.q: Ephesians 6:2 says to honour your father and whom?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:2 says to honour your father and mother.

paul.q: Romans 12:21 says to overcome evil with what?
paul.explain: Romans 12:21 says do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

paul.q: What does Galatians 6:2 tell us to carry for one another?
paul.explain: Galatians 6:2 says to bear one another's burdens.

paul.q: In Ephesians 6:10, Paul says to be strong in whom?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:10 says to be strong in the Lord and in the strength of His might.

paul.q: What had Timothy known from childhood, according to 2 Timothy 3:15?
paul.explain: 2 Timothy 3:15 says from childhood Timothy had known the holy Scriptures.

paul.q: Who wrote the letters from Romans to Philemon?
paul.explain: Romans 1:1 opens, 'Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ.'

paul.q: According to Philippians 4:19, God will supply all your what?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:19 promises that God will supply all your needs.

paul.q: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 says that in everything we should do what?
paul.explain: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 says in everything give thanks.

paul.q: Romans 8:39 says nothing can separate us from what?
paul.explain: Romans 8:38-39 says nothing can separate us from God's love in Christ Jesus.

paul.q: Philippians 2:14 says to do all things without what?
paul.explain: Philippians 2:14 says to do all things without complaining and arguing.

paul.q: Which of Paul's letters contains the love chapter?
paul.explain: The love chapter is 1 Corinthians 13.

paul.q: Which letter of Paul lists the fruit of the Spirit?
paul.explain: The fruit of the Spirit is listed in Galatians 5:22-23.

paul.q: Which letter says, 'Rejoice in the Lord always'?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:4 says to rejoice in the Lord always.

paul.q: In which letter does Paul tell Titus to appoint elders in every town?
paul.explain: Titus 1:5 says Paul left Titus in Crete to appoint elders in every town.

paul.q: According to Ephesians 2:9, why is salvation not by works?
paul.a: So that no one may boast
options: So that no one may boast
So that no one may rest
So that no one may travel
So that no one may sing
paul.explain: Ephesians 2:8-9 says salvation is not of works, so that no one can boast.

paul.q: Ephesians 6:12 says our struggle is not against what?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:12 says we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against spiritual forces of evil.

paul.q: According to Galatians 2:16, a person is justified by faith in whom?
paul.explain: Galatians 2:16 says we are justified by faith in Jesus Christ, not by works of the law.

paul.q: Galatians 5:13 says to serve one another through what?
paul.explain: Galatians 5:13 says to serve one another in love.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 13:2, if I have all faith to move mountains but no love, I am what?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:2 says without love, even mountain-moving faith leaves me nothing.

paul.q: Which of these does the love chapter say love does NOT do?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:4 says love does not envy; verses 6-7 say it rejoices with the truth, hopes and endures.

paul.q: Romans 8:1 says there is now no what for those in Christ Jesus?
paul.explain: Romans 8:1 says there is no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.

paul.q: In Romans 12:1, Paul urges us to present our bodies as what?
paul.explain: Romans 12:1 urges us to present our bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God.

paul.q: Romans 5:1 says that being justified by faith, we have peace with whom?
paul.explain: Romans 5:1 says we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

paul.q: In Philippians 4:7, what guards our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:7 says the peace of God, which surpasses understanding, will guard hearts and minds.

paul.q: According to 2 Corinthians 5:7, we walk by faith, not by what?
paul.explain: 2 Corinthians 5:7 says we walk by faith, not by sight.

paul.q: After describing the armour of God, what does Paul urge in Ephesians 6:18?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:18 urges praying at all times in the Spirit.

paul.q: In Galatians 1:6, Paul is astonished that the Galatians are turning to a different what?
paul.explain: Galatians 1:6 expresses amazement that they were turning to a different gospel.

paul.q: In Galatians 3:24, the law was a guardian to lead us to whom?
paul.explain: Galatians 3:24 says the law was our guardian (tutor) until Christ came, that we might be justified by faith.

paul.q: Whom does Romans 4:3 cite as believing God and having it counted to him as righteousness?
paul.explain: Romans 4:3 quotes Genesis: Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness.

paul.q: According to Colossians 3:14, what binds everything together in perfect unity?
paul.explain: Colossians 3:14 says to put on love, which binds everything together in perfect unity.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 8:9, Christ became poor so that we through His poverty might become what?
paul.explain: 2 Corinthians 8:9 says though He was rich, He became poor so that we might become rich.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 15:3, Christ died for our sins according to what?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 15:3 says Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:5 says 'one Lord, one faith, one ___'.
paul.explain: Ephesians 4:5 reads 'one Lord, one faith, one baptism.'

paul.q: In Philemon 1:16, Paul asks Philemon to receive Onesimus as more than a slave, as what?
paul.explain: Philemon 1:16 asks him to receive Onesimus as a beloved brother.

paul.q: Titus 3:5 says God saved us not by our works but according to His what?
paul.explain: Titus 3:5 says He saved us according to His mercy, not by works of righteousness we had done.

paul.q: Colossians 3:12 says to clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and what?
paul.explain: Paul lists the qualities God's chosen people put on like clothing.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:26 says not to let what go down while you are still angry?
paul.explain: Deal with anger quickly and do not hold on to it.

paul.q: 1 Thessalonians 5:11 says to encourage one another and do what?
paul.explain: Believers are to strengthen one another.

paul.q: Ephesians 6:4 tells fathers not to do what to their children?
paul.explain: Fathers are to bring children up in the training and instruction of the Lord.

paul.q: Who was Timothy's grandmother, mentioned in 2 Timothy 1:5?
paul.explain: Paul remembers the sincere faith that lived first in Lois and then in Eunice, Timothy's mother.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 1:3 calls God the Father of mercies and the God of all what?
paul.explain: The letter of 2 Corinthians has a strong theme of God's comfort.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:15 says to speak the truth in what?
paul.explain: Truth is to be spoken with love as we grow up into Christ.

paul.q: Colossians 3:20 says that children obeying their parents in everything pleases whom?
paul.explain: Obeying parents is well-pleasing to the Lord.

paul.q: Philippians 2:3 says in humility to value others above what?
paul.explain: Paul teaches humility and putting others first.

paul.q: Whom does 1 Timothy 2:1-2 say to pray for, along with all people?
paul.explain: Paul urges prayers for everyone, including those who govern.

paul.q: Romans 12:15 says to do what with those who weep?
paul.explain: Rejoice with those who rejoice and weep with those who weep.

paul.q: Romans 12:13 says to practise what toward guests and strangers?
paul.explain: Believers are to share with God's people and welcome others in.

paul.q: Romans 12:18 says, as far as it depends on you, live at what with everyone?
paul.explain: Paul urges us to seek peace with all people.

paul.q: Ephesians 6:2 calls honouring your father and mother the first commandment with what?
paul.explain: The commandment comes with a promise of blessing.

paul.q: Galatians 6:7 says whatever a person sows, that they will also do what?
paul.explain: Paul uses a farming picture: what you plant is what you harvest.

paul.q: Philippians 4:8 says to think about whatever is true, noble, right, pure and what?
paul.explain: Paul tells believers to fill their minds with good things.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 16:14 says to do everything in what?
paul.explain: Paul closes 1 Corinthians with a short, simple command.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 16:13 says to stand firm in what?
paul.explain: Paul tells the church to be watchful, courageous and strong.

paul.q: In 2 Timothy 2:3, Paul tells Timothy to endure hardship like a good what?
paul.explain: Paul uses the picture of a soldier of Christ Jesus.

paul.q: Ephesians 2:10 says we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do what?
paul.explain: God prepared good works in advance for us to walk in.

paul.q: Colossians 3:13 says to forgive as who forgave you?
paul.explain: We forgive others because the Lord has forgiven us.

paul.q: Romans 12:12 says to be faithful in what?
paul.explain: Paul says be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

paul.q: Which young co-worker is named with Paul in the opening greeting of Colossians?
paul.explain: Colossians begins 'Paul... and Timothy our brother'.

paul.q: Colossians 1:18 says Christ is the head of what body?
paul.explain: Christ is supreme and head of the church.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 12:21, the eye cannot say to the hand, what?
paul.explain: Every part of Christ's body is needed.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 12:4 says there are different kinds of gifts but the same what?
paul.explain: Many gifts, one Spirit who gives them.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 14:1 says to eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially which gift?
paul.explain: Paul says to pursue love and desire spiritual gifts, especially prophecy.

paul.q: Which of these gifts is listed in Romans 12:6-8?
paul.explain: The list includes prophecy, serving, teaching, encouraging, giving, leading and mercy.

paul.q: Which of these roles does Ephesians 4:11 list among Christ's gifts to the church?
paul.explain: Christ gave apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 15:20 calls Christ the what of those who have fallen asleep?
paul.explain: Christ's resurrection is the first of the harvest.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 1:4, God comforts us so that we can do what for others in trouble?
paul.explain: The comfort we receive is shared with others.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 4:7, Paul says we have this treasure in what?
paul.explain: Ordinary jars show that the power belongs to God, not us.

paul.q: According to 2 Corinthians 5:17, if anyone is in Christ, they are a what?
paul.explain: The old has gone, the new has come.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 5:20, Paul calls believers Christ's what?
paul.explain: We represent Christ as though God were making His appeal through us.

paul.q: Galatians 3:28 says that all are what in Christ Jesus?
paul.explain: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female.

paul.q: What does Galatians 5:1 say Christ has set us free for?
paul.explain: Paul urges the Galatians to stand firm and not return to slavery.

paul.q: Ephesians 2:20 calls Christ Jesus the chief what of God's household?
paul.explain: The household is built on the apostles and prophets with Christ as cornerstone.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:22-24 says to put off your old self and put on the what?
paul.explain: The new self is created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

paul.q: Colossians 3:15 says to let the peace of Christ do what in your hearts?
paul.explain: Christ's peace is to be the umpire of our hearts.

paul.q: In Philippians 3:14, Paul presses on toward the goal to win what?
paul.explain: He presses on toward the prize of God's heavenly call in Christ Jesus.

paul.q: In Philippians 1:21, Paul says that to die is what?
paul.explain: For Paul, to live is Christ and to die is gain.

paul.q: According to Romans 1:17, the righteous shall live by what?
paul.explain: The theme of Romans is righteousness by faith.

paul.q: Romans 8:37 says that in all these things we are more than what?
paul.explain: Through Christ who loved us, we overcome.

paul.q: In 1 Thessalonians 4:13, Paul says believers should not grieve like others who have no what?
paul.explain: Christians have hope because of Christ's resurrection.

paul.q: According to Romans 3:28, a person is justified by faith apart from what?
paul.explain: Justification is by faith, not by keeping the law.

paul.q: In Romans 5, one man's disobedience made many sinners. Through whose obedience will many be made righteous?
paul.explain: Adam's disobedience is set against Christ's obedience.

paul.q: Romans 11:33 marvels at the depth of the riches of God's wisdom and what?
paul.explain: Paul ends this section in worship at God's unsearchable wisdom.

paul.q: Which woman does Paul commend as a servant of the church in Cenchreae?
paul.explain: Phoebe is commended at the close of Romans.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 1:18, the message of the cross is what to those who are being saved?
paul.explain: To those perishing it is foolishness, but to believers it is God's power.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 2:2, Paul resolved to know nothing except Jesus Christ and Him what?
paul.explain: Paul focused his preaching on the cross.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 11:24, Jesus said to eat the bread in what of Him?
paul.explain: Paul passes on the words of the Lord's Supper.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 12:10, Paul says that when he is weak, then he is what?
paul.explain: Christ's power is made perfect in weakness.

paul.q: In Galatians 6:14, Paul says he will never boast except in what?
paul.a: The cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
options: The cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
paul.explain: The cross is the centre of Paul's boasting.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:3 says to keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of what?
paul.explain: Unity in the body of Christ is held by peace.

paul.q: Ephesians 5:18 says do not get drunk on wine, but be filled with what?
paul.explain: Believers are called to be continually filled with the Holy Spirit.

paul.q: Romans 6:23 says the gift of God is what?
paul.explain: The gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

paul.q: Romans 10:13 says everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be what?
paul.explain: Everyone who calls on the Lord's name will be saved.

paul.q: According to Romans 8:31, if who is for us, no one can win against us?
paul.explain: If God is for us, who can be against us?

paul.q: Romans 13:10 says love does no what to a neighbour?
paul.explain: Love does no harm to a neighbour.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 13:5, love is not easily what?
paul.explain: Love is not easily angered.

paul.q: Through whom does God give us the victory, according to 1 Corinthians 15:57?
paul.explain: Thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 10:31 says whatever you do, do it all for what?
paul.explain: Whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 9:6 says whoever sows generously will also reap how?
paul.explain: Whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 9:15, Paul gives thanks to God for what kind of gift?
paul.explain: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!

paul.q: Galatians 5:14 says the whole law is fulfilled in which command?
paul.explain: The whole law is fulfilled by: love your neighbour as yourself.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:29 says not to let what come out of your mouth?
paul.explain: Only what is helpful for building others up should come out of our mouths.

paul.q: Ephesians 5:1 says to be imitators of whom, as dearly loved children?
paul.explain: Be imitators of God, as dearly loved children.

paul.q: Philippians 4:5 says to let your what be seen by everyone?
paul.explain: Let your gentleness be evident to all.

paul.q: Colossians 3:2 says to set your mind on things where?
paul.explain: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

paul.q: Colossians 4:6 says our conversation should always be full of what?
paul.explain: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt.

paul.q: 1 Thessalonians 5:14 says to be patient with whom?
paul.explain: Be patient with everyone.

paul.q: In 1 Timothy 6:12, Paul tells Timothy to fight what?
paul.a: The good fight of the faith
options: The big battle of the town
The good fight of the faith
paul.explain: Fight the good fight of the faith.

paul.q: In 2 Timothy 2:22, Paul tells Timothy to flee from what?
paul.explain: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace.

paul.q: Titus 3:1 says to be ready for every kind of what?
paul.explain: Be ready for every good work.

paul.q: Romans 15:7 says to accept one another just as who accepted you?
paul.explain: Accept one another, just as Christ accepted you, to bring praise to God.

paul.q: In Ephesians 6:13, after you have done everything, you are to do what?
paul.explain: Put on the full armour of God so that you can stand your ground.

paul.q: Philippians 1:6 says God began a good what in you?
paul.explain: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

paul.q: Romans 12:17 says do not repay anyone evil with what?
paul.explain: Do not repay anyone evil for evil.

paul.q: 2 Thessalonians 3:13 says never to grow tired of doing what?
paul.explain: Never tire of doing what is good.

paul.q: Romans 3:24 says we are justified freely by what?
paul.explain: All are justified freely by God's grace through the redemption in Christ Jesus.

paul.q: According to Romans 10:17, faith comes from what?
paul.explain: Faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

paul.q: In Romans 8:15, what word do believers cry out to God as their Father?
paul.explain: By the Spirit of adoption we cry, 'Abba, Father.'

paul.q: Romans 10:10 says it is with your what that you believe and are justified?
paul.explain: With the heart one believes and is justified, and with the mouth one confesses and is saved.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 10:13 says that with every temptation God will also provide what?
paul.explain: God is faithful and will provide a way out so you can endure it.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 11:25, Jesus called the cup the new what in His blood?
paul.explain: This cup is the new covenant in my blood.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 12:27, each believer is what of the body of Christ?
paul.explain: You are the body of Christ, and each one of you is a part of it.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 13:1, without love Paul says he is a noisy gong or a what?
paul.explain: Without love, speaking even in the tongues of angels is only noise.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 15:52 says the dead will be raised at the sound of what?
paul.explain: The trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

paul.q: Which letter of Paul tells of a thorn in the flesh?
paul.explain: Paul was given a thorn in his flesh to keep him from becoming conceited.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 4:18 says what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is what?
paul.explain: Fix your eyes on what is unseen, since what is unseen is eternal.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 6:2 says now is the day of what?
paul.explain: Now is the time of God's favour, now is the day of salvation.

paul.q: Galatians 5:16 says if you walk by the Spirit, you will not gratify what?
paul.explain: Walk by the Spirit and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

paul.q: Which of these is a work of the flesh listed in Galatians 5:19-21?
paul.explain: Jealousy appears among the works of the flesh, in contrast to the fruit of the Spirit.

paul.q: Ephesians 2:14 says Christ Jesus Himself is our what?
paul.explain: He himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one.

paul.q: In Philippians 3:13, Paul presses on, forgetting what?
paul.explain: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on.

paul.q: Which companion does Colossians 4:14 call 'our dear friend, the doctor'?
paul.explain: Luke the doctor sends greetings in Colossians.

paul.q: In 1 Thessalonians 4:16, the Lord comes down with the voice of the archangel and the trumpet call of whom?
paul.explain: The Lord himself will come down from heaven with the trumpet call of God.

paul.q: Which letter of Paul says believers will be caught up to meet the Lord in the air?
paul.explain: We will be caught up together to meet the Lord in the air.

paul.q: According to 1 Timothy 1:15, Christ Jesus came into the world to do what?
paul.explain: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.

paul.q: Who was Timothy's mother, according to 2 Timothy 1:5?
paul.explain: Paul recalls the faith of Timothy's grandmother Lois and his mother Eunice.

paul.q: On which island did Paul leave Titus to put things in order?
paul.explain: Paul left Titus in Crete to appoint elders.

paul.q: In Philemon 1:18, Paul tells Philemon to charge what to Paul's account?
paul.explain: If Onesimus owes you anything, charge it to me.

paul.q: According to Romans 5:14, death reigned from the time of Adam to the time of whom?
paul.explain: Death reigned from Adam to Moses.

paul.q: Which couple does Paul greet as his co-workers in Christ Jesus in Romans 16:3?
paul.explain: Paul greets Priscilla and Aquila.

paul.q: Which region does Paul hope to visit in Romans 15:24?
paul.explain: Paul hopes to see the Romans on his way to Spain.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 5:7, Paul calls Christ our what?
paul.explain: Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 15:5, to whom did the risen Christ appear before the Twelve?
paul.explain: He appeared to Cephas, and then to the Twelve.

paul.q: In 2 Corinthians 11:25, how many times does Paul say he was shipwrecked?
paul.explain: Three times I was shipwrecked.

paul.q: How did Paul escape from Damascus, according to 2 Corinthians 11:33?
paul.a: Lowered in a basket through a wall
options: Lowered in a basket through a wall
paul.explain: He was lowered in a basket through an opening in the wall.

paul.q: In Ephesians 6:20, Paul calls himself an ambassador in what?
paul.explain: Paul is an ambassador in chains.

paul.q: Who does Ephesians 6:21 say will tell the readers all about Paul's news?
paul.explain: Tychicus, a dear brother and faithful servant, will tell them everything.

paul.q: Which two women does Paul urge to agree with each other in the Lord in Philippians 4:2?
paul.explain: Paul urges Euodia and Syntyche to be of the same mind.

paul.q: In 2 Timothy 4:10, who deserted Paul because he loved this world?
paul.explain: Demas, in love with this present world, had deserted Paul.

paul.q: In Philemon 1:2, Archippus is called a fellow what?
paul.explain: Paul greets Archippus our fellow soldier.

paul.q: Romans 13:1 says there is no authority except from whom?
paul.explain: Romans 13:1 says all authority is established by God.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 9:24, Paul compares the Christian life to running what?
paul.explain: Paul says runners in a race all run, so run to win the prize.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 3:2, what did Paul feed the Corinthians instead of solid food?
paul.explain: Paul gave them milk because they were not yet ready for solid food.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 4:6 says God commanded light to shine out of what?
paul.explain: God who said light shall shine out of darkness has shone in our hearts.

paul.q: Galatians 6:10 says to do good to everyone, especially those of the household of what?
paul.explain: Paul says to do good especially to the household of faith.

paul.q: Ephesians 1:13 says believers are sealed with the promised what?
paul.explain: Believers are sealed with the promised Holy Spirit.

paul.q: Philippians 2:11 says every tongue will confess that Jesus Christ is what?
paul.explain: Every tongue will confess that Jesus Christ is Lord.

paul.q: Colossians 3:3 says your life is hidden with Christ in whom?
paul.explain: Your life is hidden with Christ in God.

paul.q: 1 Thessalonians 4:11 says to work with your own what?
paul.explain: Paul urges them to work with their hands.

paul.q: 1 Timothy 6:6 says godliness with what is great gain?
paul.explain: Godliness with contentment is great gain.

paul.q: Romans 12:9 says to hate what is evil and hold fast to what?
paul.explain: Romans 12:9 says to abhor evil and cling to what is good.

paul.q: Romans 12:14 says to bless those who do what to you?
paul.explain: Paul says to bless those who persecute you and not curse them.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 6:19 says your body is a temple of what?
paul.explain: Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you.

paul.q: Galatians 3:26 says we are all children of God through faith in whom?
paul.explain: We are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

paul.q: 2 Thessalonians 3:3 says the Lord is what, and will guard you from the evil one?
paul.explain: The Lord is faithful and will strengthen and guard you.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 13:11, when Paul became a man, he put away what?
paul.explain: Paul says he put away childish things when he became a man.

paul.q: Ephesians 2:4 says God is rich in what?
paul.explain: Because of His great love, God is rich in mercy.

paul.q: Philippians 2:8 says Christ was obedient to death, even death on a what?
paul.explain: Christ humbled himself and was obedient even to death on a cross.

paul.q: Romans 5:3-4 says that character produces what?
paul.explain: Suffering produces perseverance, perseverance character, and character hope.

paul.q: Romans 4:20-21 says Abraham was fully convinced that God was able to do what?
paul.explain: Abraham was fully assured that God could do what He had promised.

paul.q: Romans 14:1 says to welcome the one who is weak in what?
paul.explain: Romans 14:1 says to welcome the one who is weak in faith, not to quarrel over opinions.

paul.q: Romans 13:8 says to owe nothing to anyone except what?
paul.explain: Romans 13:8 says owe no one anything except to love one another.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 1:12, which of these did some quarrelling Corinthians say they followed?
paul.explain: Some said 'I follow Paul', others Apollos, Cephas or Christ.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 3:6, Paul planted and Apollos watered, but who gave the growth?
paul.explain: Paul planted and Apollos watered, but God gave the growth.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 14:33 says God is not a God of confusion but of what?
paul.explain: God is not a God of confusion but of peace.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 4:16 says our inner self is being what day by day?
paul.explain: Though the outer self wastes away, the inner self is renewed day by day.

paul.q: Galatians 3:7 says those who have faith are sons of whom?
paul.explain: Those who have faith are sons of Abraham.

paul.q: Ephesians 2:15 says Christ made Jew and Gentile into one new what?
paul.explain: Christ created in himself one new man out of the two.

paul.q: In Philippians 1:21, Paul says that to live is whom?
paul.explain: For Paul, to live is Christ and to die is gain.

paul.q: Colossians 1:17 says that in Christ all things do what?
paul.explain: Christ is before all things and in him all things hold together.

paul.q: 1 Thessalonians 5:2 says the day of the Lord comes like a what in the night?
paul.explain: The day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

paul.q: 1 Timothy 6:7 says we brought what into the world?
paul.explain: We brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out.

paul.q: Philemon 1:7 says the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through whom?
paul.explain: Paul had great joy because Philemon refreshed the hearts of the saints.

paul.q: 1 Timothy 2:5 says there is one God and one mediator between God and men. Who is he?
paul.explain: The one mediator between God and men is the man Christ Jesus.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 12:13, Jews or Greeks, slaves or free, were all baptized by one Spirit into one what?
paul.explain: By one Spirit we were all baptized into one body.

paul.q: 2 Thessalonians 3:12 urges people to work quietly and eat whose bread?
paul.explain: Paul urges them to work quietly and earn their own living.

paul.q: Romans 8:26 says the Spirit helps us in our weakness by doing what?
paul.explain: The Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words.

paul.q: In Romans 11, Gentile believers are pictured as wild branches grafted into what kind of tree?
paul.explain: Paul describes a wild olive branch grafted in among the natural branches.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 8:4 says an idol is what in the world?
paul.explain: Paul says an idol is nothing in the world and there is no God but one.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 5:18 says God gave us the ministry of what?
paul.explain: God reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation.

paul.q: Galatians 1:8 says that even who, if he preached a different gospel, should be accursed?
paul.explain: Paul says even an angel from heaven who preaches a different gospel should be accursed.

paul.q: 2 Timothy 2:15 says to be a worker who need not be ashamed, rightly handling the word of what?
paul.explain: Paul urges Timothy to be an approved worker rightly handling the word of truth.

paul.q: Which of these must an overseer be, according to 1 Timothy 3:2?
paul.explain: An overseer must be above reproach and able to teach.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 1:27 says God chose the foolish things of the world to shame whom?
paul.explain: God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise.

paul.q: Which two blessings does Paul pair in the greeting of Romans 1:7?
paul.explain: Paul greets the Romans with grace and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paul.q: Which of these is a fruit of the Spirit in Galatians 5:22?
paul.explain: Goodness is part of the fruit of the Spirit.

paul.q: Which of these does Colossians 3:8 tell us to put away?
paul.explain: Colossians 3:8 says to put away anger, wrath and malice.

paul.q: Colossians 3:9 says not to do what to one another?
paul.explain: Having put off the old self, believers are not to lie to each other.

paul.q: Colossians 3:16 says to sing psalms, hymns and what?
paul.explain: We are to sing psalms, hymns and spiritual songs with thankfulness to God.

paul.q: Ephesians 2:8 says salvation is not from yourselves; it is the what of God?
paul.explain: Salvation is the gift of God, received by grace through faith.

paul.q: In Philippians 4:12, Paul has learned to be content whether well fed or what?
paul.explain: Paul learned the secret of being content when full or hungry.

paul.q: Philippians 2:15 says that believers shine like what in the world?
paul.explain: Believers shine as lights in the world.

paul.q: Romans 12:20 says that if your enemy is hungry, you should do what?
paul.explain: If your enemy is hungry, feed him.

paul.q: In Romans 10:15, which part of the body is called 'beautiful' on those who bring good news?
paul.explain: How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 12:26, if one part of the body suffers, what happens?
paul.explain: If one member suffers, all the members suffer with it.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 14:40 says everything should be done decently and how?
paul.explain: Let all things be done decently and in order.

paul.q: In 2 Timothy 4:2, Paul tells Timothy to preach what?
paul.explain: Paul charges Timothy to preach the word.

paul.q: Philippians 2:9 says God gave Jesus the name that is above what?
paul.explain: After Christ's humility, God highly exalted Him and gave Him the name above every name.

paul.q: In Philippians 2:22, Timothy served with Paul in the gospel like a son with his what?
paul.explain: Paul says Timothy served with him like a son with a father.

paul.q: Which man brought the Philippians' gift to Paul in prison, according to Philippians 4:18?
paul.explain: Paul received the Philippians' gift through Epaphroditus.

paul.q: In 2 Timothy 4:11, who alone is with Paul?
paul.explain: Near the end of his life Paul writes, 'Only Luke is with me.'

paul.q: Romans 16:16 says to greet one another with a holy what?
paul.explain: Paul tells the Romans to greet one another with a holy kiss.

paul.q: 2 Corinthians 8:1 praises the generous giving of the churches in which region?
paul.explain: The churches of Macedonia gave generously even in deep poverty.

paul.q: Which of these does Romans 8:35 list as unable to separate us from Christ's love?
paul.explain: Romans 8:35 lists tribulation, distress, persecution, famine, nakedness, peril and sword.

paul.q: Romans 8:32 says God did not spare His own what?
paul.explain: God did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 13:7 says love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and does what?
paul.explain: Love endures all things.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 15:55, Paul asks, 'O death, where is your what?'
paul.explain: Because of Christ's resurrection, death has lost its sting.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:25 says to speak truth with your neighbour because we are what of one another?
paul.explain: We are members of one another, so we speak the truth.

paul.q: Romans 2:4 says God's kindness is meant to lead you to what?
paul.explain: God's kindness leads people to repentance.

paul.q: Romans 13:12 says to put on the armour of what?
paul.explain: Paul urges us to lay aside the works of darkness and put on the armour of light.

paul.q: In 1 Thessalonians 5:8, the breastplate is faith and what?
paul.explain: The breastplate is faith and love, and the helmet is the hope of salvation.

paul.q: In Philemon 1:22, Paul asks Philemon to prepare what for him?
paul.explain: Paul hopes to visit and asks Philemon to prepare a guest room.

paul.q: 1 Corinthians 16:2 says to set aside money for the collection on which day?
paul.a: The first day of every week
options: The first day of every week
At the end of each month
paul.explain: Paul told each person to set something aside on the first day of every week.

paul.q: Romans 15:26 says the contribution from Macedonia and Achaia was for the poor among the saints in which city?
paul.explain: Macedonia and Achaia gave for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.

paul.q: Colossians 4:16 says the letter should also be read in the church of which city?
paul.explain: The Colossians were to see that the letter was also read in the church of the Laodiceans.

paul.q: In 2 Timothy 4:13, at which city did Paul leave his cloak?
paul.explain: Paul asked Timothy to bring the cloak he left with Carpus at Troas.

paul.q: Which two co-workers join Paul in greeting the church in 1 Thessalonians 1:1?
paul.explain: 1 Thessalonians opens from Paul, Silvanus and Timothy.

paul.q: Philemon 1:24 lists Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and whom as Paul's fellow workers?
paul.explain: Paul names Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke as fellow workers.

paul.q: Who taught the Colossians the gospel and is called 'our beloved fellow servant' in Colossians 1:7?
paul.explain: The Colossians learned the gospel from Epaphras.

paul.q: Ephesians 3:20 says God can do far more than all we ask or what?
paul.explain: God is able to do exceedingly more than all we ask or think.

paul.q: In Philippians 2:27, Epaphroditus was sick almost to the point of what?
paul.explain: Epaphroditus was ill, near to death, but God had mercy on him.

generalrev.q: Jesus says, "Behold, I stand at the door and ___."
generalrev.explain: In Revelation 3:20 Jesus stands at the door and knocks.

generalrev.q: Who will wipe away every tear from our eyes in heaven?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:4 says God will wipe away every tear.

generalrev.q: Finish the verse: "God is ___."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:8 tells us that God is love.

generalrev.q: "Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and ___."
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:8 says Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

generalrev.q: If we need wisdom, whom does James say we should ask?
generalrev.explain: James 1:5 says to ask God, who gives generously.

generalrev.q: According to 1 Peter 5:7, why can we give our worries to God?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 5:7 says to give God our worries because he cares for you.

generalrev.q: "If we confess our sins, God will ___ us."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 1:9 promises that God forgives us when we confess our sins.

generalrev.q: Which book is the very last book of the Bible?
generalrev.explain: Revelation ends the Bible, closing at Revelation 22:21.

generalrev.q: What were the streets of the city of heaven made of?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:21 says the street of the city was pure gold.

generalrev.q: What was each of the twelve gates of the new city made of?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:21 says each gate was made of a single pearl.

generalrev.q: Who built an ark by faith to save his family?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:7 says Noah by faith built an ark.

generalrev.q: Who obeyed God by faith and went out not knowing where he was going?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:8 says Abraham obeyed and went out not knowing where he was going.

generalrev.q: Which hero of faith refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:24 says Moses refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.

generalrev.q: By faith, the walls of which city fell after the Israelites marched around them for seven days?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:30 says the walls of Jericho fell by faith.

generalrev.q: Which woman in Hebrews 11 welcomed the spies in peace and was spared?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:31 says Rahab welcomed the spies and did not perish.

generalrev.q: According to Hebrews 11, who was taken from this life so that he did not experience death?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:5 says by faith Enoch was taken so that he did not see death.

generalrev.q: James says, "Faith without ___ is dead."
generalrev.explain: James 2:17 says faith by itself, if it has no works, is dead.

generalrev.q: James compares which small part of the body to a fire that can set a forest ablaze?
generalrev.explain: James 3:5-6 says the tongue is a small part but is like a fire.

generalrev.q: James says to consider it pure joy whenever you face what?
generalrev.explain: James 1:2 says to count it joy when you face trials of many kinds.

generalrev.q: "Resist the devil, and he will ___ from you."
generalrev.explain: James 4:7 promises the devil will flee when we resist him.

generalrev.q: Abraham was called what of God?
generalrev.explain: James 2:23 says Abraham was called the friend of God.

generalrev.q: "I saw a new heaven and a new ___."
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:1 says John saw a new heaven and a new earth.

generalrev.q: By faith, which son did Abraham offer up when God tested him?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:17 says Abraham offered up Isaac.

generalrev.q: Peter says the devil prowls around like what kind of animal?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 5:8 says the devil prowls around like a roaring lion.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:2 tells us to fix our eyes on whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:2 says to fix our eyes on Jesus.

generalrev.q: "We love because he first ___ us."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:19 says we love because God first loved us.

generalrev.q: How many churches are addressed in the letters of Revelation 2 and 3?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:11 sends the message to seven churches in Asia.

generalrev.q: The Lord says, "I am the Alpha and the ___."
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:8 says, "I am the Alpha and the Omega."

generalrev.q: On which island was John when he received the revelation?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:9 says John was on the island of Patmos.

generalrev.q: Hebrews says Jesus is a priest forever in the order of whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 5:6 says Jesus is a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.

generalrev.q: Which church was told it had forsaken its first love?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 2:4 tells the church in Ephesus it left its first love.

generalrev.q: Which church was rebuked for being neither hot nor cold?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:16 rebukes Laodicea as lukewarm.

generalrev.q: What name is given to the holy city John saw coming down out of heaven from God?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:2 calls it the holy city, the new Jerusalem.

generalrev.q: Which archangel is said to have disputed with the devil about the body of Moses?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:9 names the archangel Michael.

generalrev.q: John writes that we have what with the Father in Jesus Christ the righteous?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 2:1 says we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5:5, Jesus is called the Lion of which tribe?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 5:5 calls him the Lion of the tribe of Judah.

generalrev.q: Peter calls believers "a royal ___."
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 2:9 calls believers a royal priesthood.

generalrev.q: "The word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged ___."
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 4:12 says God's word is sharper than any two-edged sword.

generalrev.q: Who received strength by faith to become a mother, because she trusted God to keep his promise?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:11 says Sarah considered God faithful who had promised.

generalrev.q: James 1:19 says everyone should be quick to do what?
generalrev.explain: James 1:19 says to be quick to listen, slow to speak, slow to anger.

generalrev.q: 1 John 3:1 says God's great love lets us be called what?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 3:1 says we are called children of God.

generalrev.q: 1 John 4:18 says perfect love drives out what?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:18 says perfect love casts out fear.

generalrev.q: What gives light to the new city so that it needs no sun?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:23 says the glory of God gives the city light, and the Lamb is its lamp.

generalrev.q: What grows beside the river of the water of life in the new city?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:2 describes the tree of life on either side of the river.

generalrev.q: By faith, the Israelites passed through which sea as on dry land?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:29 says by faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land.

generalrev.q: When John fell at Jesus' feet, what did Jesus tell him?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:17 says Jesus laid his right hand on John and said, do not be afraid.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 7:9, the great crowd from every nation wore what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 7:9 says they were clothed in white robes with palm branches in their hands.

generalrev.q: According to Hebrews 11:6, without faith it is impossible to do what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:6 says without faith it is impossible to please God.

generalrev.q: What promise does God make to us in Hebrews 13:5?
options: He will come back next year
He will let us decide alone
He will stay only on Sundays
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:5 says God will never leave you nor forsake you.

generalrev.q: 1 John 1:5 says that God is what?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 1:5 says God is light and in him is no darkness at all.

generalrev.q: Jude 1:24 says God is able to keep us from what?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:24 praises him who is able to keep you from falling.

generalrev.q: In 2 Peter 3:9, the Lord is what toward us?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 3:9 says the Lord is patient, not wanting anyone to perish.

generalrev.q: James 4:8 says if we draw near to God, he will do what?
generalrev.explain: James 4:8 says, draw near to God and he will draw near to you.

generalrev.q: Which of these men is named among the heroes of faith in Hebrews 11:32?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:32 names Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David and Samuel.

generalrev.q: For how long did Moses' parents hide him by faith?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:23 says Moses was hidden for three months by his parents.

generalrev.q: Which prophet does James say prayed earnestly that it would not rain?
generalrev.explain: James 5:17 says Elijah prayed earnestly that it would not rain.

generalrev.q: James compares the tongue to what small thing that steers a great ship?
generalrev.explain: James 3:4 says ships are steered by a very small rudder.

generalrev.q: James says even who believe that there is one God, and shudder?
generalrev.explain: James 2:19 says even the demons believe and shudder.

generalrev.q: Peter says believers, like living stones, are being built into what?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 2:5 says you are being built up as a spiritual house.

generalrev.q: Peter compares the testing of our faith to which precious metal refined by fire?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 1:7 compares tested faith to gold refined by fire.

generalrev.q: With the Lord, one day is like how many years?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 3:8 says one day is with the Lord as a thousand years.

generalrev.q: By faith, who offered God a better sacrifice than Cain?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:4 says by faith Abel offered a better sacrifice than Cain.

generalrev.q: James says every good and perfect gift comes down from whom?
generalrev.explain: James 1:17 says every good gift comes from the Father of lights.

generalrev.q: Jude urges believers to do what for the faith once delivered to the saints?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:3 urges us to contend earnestly for the faith.

generalrev.q: Which of these cities had one of the seven churches of Revelation?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 2:18 addresses the church in Thyatira.

generalrev.q: Which church was told, "I have set before you an open door which no one can shut"?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:8 gives Philadelphia an open door no one can shut.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5, who is found worthy to open the scroll?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 5:9 says the Lamb is worthy to take the scroll and open its seals.

generalrev.q: Whose names were on the twelve foundations of the wall of the new Jerusalem?
generalrev.a: The twelve apostles of the Lamb
options: The twelve apostles of the Lamb
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:14 says the foundations bear the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

generalrev.q: In 3 John, which man is described as loving to be first among them?
generalrev.explain: 3 John 1:9 names Diotrephes, who loves to be first.

generalrev.q: 2 John is addressed to whom?
generalrev.a: The chosen lady and her children
options: The chosen lady and her children
generalrev.explain: 2 John 1:1 greets the chosen lady and her children.

generalrev.q: Jude calls himself a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of whom?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:1 calls him the brother of James.

generalrev.q: Which church was told, "Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life"?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 2:10 gives this word to the church in Smyrna.

generalrev.q: Which church had a reputation for being alive, yet was dead?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:1 tells Sardis it has a name of being alive but is dead.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:6 says the Lord disciplines whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:6 says the Lord disciplines the one he loves.

generalrev.q: 3 John says there is no greater joy than to hear that his children are doing what?
generalrev.explain: 3 John 1:4 says no greater joy than to hear my children walk in truth.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 22:13, Jesus calls himself the Alpha and Omega, the Beginning and the what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:13 says, I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end.

generalrev.q: With what can we come to God's throne of grace?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 4:16 invites us to approach the throne of grace with confidence to receive mercy and help.

generalrev.q: Who is our great high priest who has gone into heaven?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 4:14 says we have a great high priest, Jesus the Son of God.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 13:2 says some people have welcomed whom without knowing it?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:2 says some have shown hospitality to angels without knowing it.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 10:25 says not to give up what together?
generalrev.explain: We are told not to give up meeting together but to encourage one another.

generalrev.q: What does James 5:13 say a cheerful person should do?
generalrev.explain: James 5:13 says if anyone is cheerful, let them sing songs of praise.

generalrev.q: According to James 4:6, God gives grace to whom?
generalrev.explain: God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 5:6 says if we humble ourselves, God will do what in due time?
generalrev.explain: Humble yourselves under God's mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 4:8 says love covers what?
generalrev.explain: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers a multitude of sins.

generalrev.q: According to 1 John 4:7, where does love come from?
generalrev.explain: Love comes from God, and everyone who loves is born of God.

generalrev.q: 1 John 4:4 says the One in you is what than the one in the world?
generalrev.explain: God, who is in believers, is greater than the one who is in the world.

generalrev.q: 1 John 1:7 says the blood of Jesus purifies us from what?
generalrev.explain: The blood of Jesus his Son purifies us from all sin.

generalrev.q: In John's vision, what encircled God's throne, shining like an emerald?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 4:3 describes a rainbow shining like an emerald around the throne.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 19:11, the rider on the white horse is called Faithful and what?
generalrev.explain: The rider is called Faithful and True.

generalrev.q: What flows from the throne of God and of the Lamb?
generalrev.a: The river of the water of life
options: The river of the water of life
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:1 shows the river of the water of life, clear as crystal, flowing from the throne.

generalrev.q: Jude 1:2 prays for mercy, peace and what to be yours in abundance?
generalrev.explain: Jude greets believers: Mercy, peace and love be yours in abundance.

generalrev.q: 2 Peter 3:18 says to grow in the grace and what of our Lord Jesus?
generalrev.explain: Peter ends by urging us to grow in grace and knowledge of Jesus.

generalrev.q: Where does God make his home with his people in the new creation?
generalrev.explain: A loud voice says God's dwelling is now among his people, and he will be with them.

generalrev.q: When we ask God for wisdom, James 1:6 says we should not do what?
generalrev.explain: We must ask in faith, not doubting.

generalrev.q: 1 John 3:18 says to love not just with words but with what?
generalrev.explain: John says to love not with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

generalrev.q: What is said about the gates of the new city in Revelation 21:25?
generalrev.explain: Its gates will never be shut, for there is no night there.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 1:3 calls the Son the radiance of what?
generalrev.explain: The Son is the radiance of God's glory and the exact representation of his being.

generalrev.q: Although Jesus was tempted in every way as we are, what was he?
generalrev.explain: Our high priest sympathizes with our weaknesses yet was without sin.

generalrev.q: Why can Jesus save completely those who come to God through him, per Hebrews 7:25?
generalrev.a: He always lives to intercede for them
options: He has retired from his work
He always lives to intercede for them
generalrev.explain: Jesus always lives to intercede for those who draw near to God through him.

generalrev.q: How many times did Jesus offer his body as a sacrifice, according to Hebrews 10:10?
generalrev.explain: We have been made holy through the sacrifice of Jesus once for all.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 6:19 calls our hope an anchor for what?
generalrev.explain: This hope is an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

generalrev.q: Which hero of faith, as he was dying, gave instructions about his bones?
generalrev.explain: By faith Joseph spoke of the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.

generalrev.q: Esau traded his birthright for what, according to Hebrews 12:16?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:16 says Esau sold his inheritance rights as the oldest son for a single meal.

generalrev.q: James 1:27 says pure religion looks after whom in their distress?
generalrev.explain: Religion that God accepts looks after orphans and widows in their distress.

generalrev.q: James 4:14 compares life to what?
generalrev.explain: Life is a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 1:3 says we have been born again into a living hope through what?
generalrev.a: The resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead
options: The resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead
generalrev.explain: By God's mercy we have a living hope through Jesus' resurrection from the dead.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 1:18-19 says we were redeemed not with silver or gold, but with what?
generalrev.explain: We were redeemed with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 4:12 says not to be surprised at what?
generalrev.a: The fiery ordeal that comes to test you
options: The fiery ordeal that comes to test you
generalrev.explain: Peter tells believers not to be surprised at the fiery ordeal that has come on them as testing.

generalrev.q: According to 1 John 5:4, what is the victory that has overcome the world?
generalrev.explain: This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

generalrev.q: How does John end his first letter, in 1 John 5:21?
generalrev.explain: The final words of 1 John are: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.

generalrev.q: Jude 1:22 says to be merciful to whom?
generalrev.explain: Jude says: Be merciful to those who doubt.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 2:17, the one who is victorious receives a white stone with what written on it?
generalrev.explain: Jesus promises a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it.

generalrev.q: What do the four living creatures cry day and night in Revelation 4:8?
generalrev.explain: They never stop saying: Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5:6, how did the Lamb appear standing in the throne room?
generalrev.a: As though it had been slain
options: As though it had been slain
generalrev.explain: John saw a Lamb looking as if it had been slain, standing at the center of the throne.

generalrev.q: What title is written on the rider's robe and thigh in Revelation 19:16?
generalrev.a: King of kings and Lord of lords
options: King of kings and Lord of lords
generalrev.explain: On his robe and thigh is written: King of kings and Lord of lords.

generalrev.q: What is the final verse of the Bible about?
generalrev.a: The grace of the Lord Jesus
options: The grace of the Lord Jesus
generalrev.explain: The Bible ends: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God's people. Amen.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 7:2 says the name of Melchizedek, king of Salem, means king of what?
generalrev.explain: Melchizedek is king of righteousness, and also king of Salem, meaning king of peace.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:24 says the sprinkled blood of Jesus speaks a better word than the blood of whom?
generalrev.explain: Jesus' blood speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

generalrev.q: According to James 5:14, whom should a sick person call to pray over them?
generalrev.explain: The sick person should call the elders of the church to pray and anoint with oil in the Lord's name.

generalrev.q: How many people does 1 Peter 3:20 say were saved through water in Noah's ark?
generalrev.explain: Only a few people, eight in all, were saved through water.

generalrev.q: In 2 Peter 3:15-16, whose letters does Peter mention as containing some hard-to-understand things?
generalrev.explain: Peter refers to our dear brother Paul and his letters.

generalrev.q: To whom is the letter of 3 John addressed?
generalrev.explain: 3 John begins: The elder, to my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

generalrev.q: Along with Cain and Balaam, Jude 1:11 names the rebellion of whom?
generalrev.explain: Jude warns of the way of Cain, the error of Balaam and the rebellion of Korah.

generalrev.q: John addresses the seven churches located in which Roman province?
generalrev.explain: John writes to the seven churches in the province of Asia.

generalrev.q: In which city was Antipas, the faithful witness, put to death?
generalrev.explain: Jesus mentions Antipas, my faithful witness, put to death in Pergamum.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5:8, the golden bowls of incense are said to be what?
generalrev.explain: The elders held golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God's people.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 11:33 says that through faith people shut the mouths of what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:33 says through faith they shut the mouths of lions.

generalrev.q: In Hebrews 13:6, what do we say the Lord is to us?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:6 says, "The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid."

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:1 says we are surrounded by a great cloud of what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:1 says we are surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses.

generalrev.q: James 5:11 reminds us of the perseverance of which man?
generalrev.explain: James 5:11 points to the perseverance of Job.

generalrev.q: James 1:22 says do not merely listen to the word, but do what?
generalrev.explain: James 1:22 says to do what the word says.

generalrev.q: In 1 Peter 2:2, newborn babies crave what?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 2:2 says to crave pure spiritual milk like newborn babies, so you can grow.

generalrev.q: In 1 Peter 5:4, what is Jesus called?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 5:4 calls Jesus the Chief Shepherd.

generalrev.q: 1 John 4:11 says since God loved us, we also ought to do what?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:11 says we ought to love one another.

generalrev.q: In John's vision, Jesus' voice was like the sound of what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:15 says his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.

generalrev.q: How many elders sat on thrones around God's throne in Revelation 4:4?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 4:4 describes twenty-four elders on thrones around God's throne.

generalrev.q: How many horns did the Lamb have in Revelation 5:6?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 5:6 says the Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes.

generalrev.q: How many gates did the wall of the new Jerusalem have?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:12 says the city wall had twelve gates.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 21:5, what does the One on the throne say he is making new?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:5 says, "I am making everything new!"

generalrev.q: By faith, Abraham lived in the promised land in what kind of homes?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:9 says Abraham lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob.

generalrev.q: Jude 1:21 says to keep yourselves in what?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:21 says, "Keep yourselves in God's love."

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 2:24 says that by Jesus' what have we been healed?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 2:24 says, "By his wounds you have been healed."

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:1 says to run the race marked out for us with what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:1 says to run with perseverance the race marked out for us.

generalrev.q: In James 3:3, we put bits into the mouths of what animals to make them obey us?
generalrev.explain: James 3:3 says we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us.

generalrev.q: James 1:23 compares someone who hears but does not do the word to a person looking at what?
generalrev.explain: James 1:23-24 says such a person is like someone who looks at his face in a mirror and forgets what he looks like.

generalrev.q: In 1 Peter 2:9, God called us out of darkness into what?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 2:9 says God called us out of darkness into his wonderful light.

generalrev.q: In Hebrews 3:5, Moses was faithful in all God's house as what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 3:5-6 says Moses was faithful as a servant, but Christ is faithful as the Son over God's house.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 1:6 says what should all God's angels do for the Son?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 1:6 says, "Let all God's angels worship him."

generalrev.q: What portion of everything did Abraham give to Melchizedek in Hebrews 7:2?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 7:2 says Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 11:1 says faith is being sure of what we hope for and certain of what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:1 says faith is being certain of what we do not see.

generalrev.q: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing whose anger?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:27 says Moses left Egypt not fearing the king's anger.

generalrev.q: James 3:8 says no human being can do what to the tongue?
generalrev.explain: James 3:8 says no human being can tame the tongue.

generalrev.q: James 2:26 says faith without deeds is like a body without what?
generalrev.explain: James 2:26 says as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

generalrev.q: James 2:8 calls the command to love your neighbor as yourself what?
generalrev.explain: James 2:8 calls it the royal law found in Scripture.

generalrev.q: In James 5:7, to whom is patient waiting compared?
generalrev.a: A farmer waiting for his crop
options: A farmer waiting for his crop
generalrev.explain: James 5:7 says to be patient like a farmer who waits for the land to yield its valuable crop.

generalrev.q: In 1 Peter 2:6, Christ is the chosen and precious what?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 2:6 calls Christ a chosen and precious cornerstone.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 4:16 says if you suffer as a Christian, you should not be what?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 4:16 says not to be ashamed but to praise God that you bear that name.

generalrev.q: The list of qualities to add to faith in 2 Peter 1:5-7 ends with what?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 1:7 ends the list with mutual affection and love.

generalrev.q: 1 John 4:1 says we should do what with the spirits?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:1 says to test the spirits to see whether they are from God.

generalrev.q: Why did John write his first letter, according to 1 John 5:13?
generalrev.a: So we may know we have eternal life
options: So we may know we have eternal life
So we would fear the future
generalrev.explain: 1 John 5:13 says he wrote so that you may know that you have eternal life.

generalrev.q: According to 1 John 3:8, why did the Son of God appear?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 3:8 says the Son of God appeared to destroy the devil's work.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 1:20, the seven golden lampstands represent what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:20 says the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

generalrev.q: Unless Ephesus repented, what would Jesus remove from its place in Revelation 2:5?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 2:5 says Jesus would remove their lampstand unless they repented.

generalrev.q: Jesus told the church in Smyrna that although they were poor, they were actually what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 2:9 says, "I know your poverty - yet you are rich!"

generalrev.q: What did the church in Laodicea say about itself in Revelation 3:17?
generalrev.a: That it was rich and needed nothing
options: That it was rich and needed nothing
That it was weak and hungry
generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:17 says they claimed, "I am rich; I have acquired wealth and do not need a thing," yet were wretched and blind.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5:9, the Lamb purchased people for God with what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 5:9 says the Lamb purchased people for God with his blood.

generalrev.q: According to Hebrews 12:2, for what did Jesus endure the cross?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:2 says that for the joy set before him he endured the cross, scorning its shame.

generalrev.q: According to 2 Peter 1:21, prophets spoke from God as they were carried along by whom?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 1:21 says prophets spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

generalrev.q: Why did John weep in Revelation 5:4?
generalrev.a: No one was found worthy to open the scroll
options: No one was found worthy to open the scroll
generalrev.explain: Revelation 5:4 says John wept because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 22:2, the leaves of the tree of life are for the healing of what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:2 says the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

generalrev.q: By faith, Jacob worshiped as he leaned on the top of his what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:21 says Jacob worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

generalrev.q: In 2 Peter 1:16, the apostles describe themselves as what of Jesus' majesty?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 1:16 says they were eyewitnesses of his majesty, not following cleverly invented stories.

generalrev.q: Jude 1:14 calls which man the seventh from Adam who prophesied?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:14 says Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 4:11, why is the Lord worthy to receive glory, honor and power?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 4:11 says he is worthy because he created all things.

generalrev.q: 1 John 4:2 says every spirit from God acknowledges what about Jesus Christ?
generalrev.a: That he has come in the flesh
options: That he has come in the flesh
That he was only an angel
That he was a prophet only
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:2 says every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 7:26 says our high priest is set apart from whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 7:26 says he is holy, blameless, pure, set apart from sinners.

generalrev.q: What does Jesus say about his coming in Revelation 22:20?
options: He is coming in a hundred years
generalrev.explain: In Revelation 22:20 Jesus says he is coming soon (quickly, in the KJV).

generalrev.q: In Revelation 22:17, how is the water of life offered to anyone who is thirsty?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:17 invites whoever wishes to take the water of life freely.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 19:7, what are we invited to do?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 19:7 says, "Let us rejoice and be glad and give him the glory."

generalrev.q: Revelation 22:5 says there will be no more what in the new city?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:5 says there will be no more night, because the Lord God gives them light.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 13:20 calls Jesus the great what of the sheep?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:20 calls Jesus the great Shepherd of the sheep.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 13:15 says we should continually offer God a sacrifice of what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:15 says to continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise.

generalrev.q: James 5:16 says to confess our sins to each other and do what for one another?
generalrev.explain: James 5:16 says to pray for one another.

generalrev.q: According to 1 John 5:14, God hears us when we ask according to what?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 5:14 says that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 7:16, the people of God will no longer be what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 7:16 says they will hunger no more and thirst no more.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 13:16 says not to forget to do good and to do what with others?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:16 says to do good and to share with others.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 3:11 says to seek what and pursue it?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 3:11 says to seek peace and pursue it.

generalrev.q: According to Revelation 1:7, Jesus is coming with what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:7 says, "Behold, he is coming with the clouds."

generalrev.q: According to 1 John 4:14, whom did the Father send to be the Savior of the world?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:14 says the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

generalrev.q: What has Jesus promised us, according to 1 John 2:25?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 2:25 says the promise he made to us is eternal life.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 6:10 says God will not do what to our work and love for him?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 6:10 says God is not unjust, so he will not forget our work and love.

generalrev.q: Revelation 1:5 says Jesus Christ does what for us?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:5 speaks of him who loves us and freed us from our sins by his blood.

generalrev.q: In the new covenant of Hebrews 8:10, where does God say he will write his laws?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 8:10 says God will put his laws in their minds and write them on their hearts.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 9:22 says without the shedding of what is there no forgiveness?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 9:22 says without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 10:24 says to consider how to spur one another on toward what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 10:24 urges us to spur one another on toward love and good deeds.

generalrev.q: By faith, Isaac blessed which two sons concerning things to come?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:20 says by faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau.

generalrev.q: Abraham looked forward to a city whose builder and maker is whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:10 says Abraham looked for the city whose architect and builder is God.

generalrev.q: James 1:12 says the one who perseveres under trial will receive what?
generalrev.explain: James 1:12 promises the crown of life to those who stand the test.

generalrev.q: James 4:4 says friendship with the world is hostility toward whom?
generalrev.explain: James 4:4 says friendship with the world is enmity with God.

generalrev.q: Why does 1 Peter 1:16 say we must be holy?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 1:16 says, "Be holy, for I am holy."

generalrev.q: 1 John 1:8 says if we claim to have no sin, whom do we deceive?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 1:8 says if we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves.

generalrev.q: 1 John 4:20 says whoever does not love a brother he has seen cannot love whom?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:20 says he cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

generalrev.q: 2 Peter 3:10 says the day of the Lord will come like what?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 3:10 says the day of the Lord will come like a thief.

generalrev.q: Jude 1:7 gives which two cities as an example of those who suffered eternal fire?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:7 names Sodom and Gomorrah as an example.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 20:10, into what was the devil thrown?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 20:10 says the devil was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 12:3, what color was the great dragon?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 12:3 describes a great red dragon with seven heads and ten horns.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 3:12, the one who overcomes will be made what in the temple of God?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:12 says the one who overcomes will be made a pillar in the temple of God.

generalrev.q: For how long did those who were beheaded for Jesus reign with Christ in Revelation 20:4?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 20:4 says they reigned with Christ a thousand years.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 11:3, in what are the two witnesses clothed?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 11:3 says the two witnesses prophesy clothed in sackcloth.

generalrev.q: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about how long?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 8:1 says there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

generalrev.q: What was written on the foreheads of the 144,000 standing with the Lamb in Revelation 14:1?
generalrev.a: The Lamb's name and his Father's name
options: The Lamb's name and his Father's name
The names of the twelve tribes
generalrev.explain: Revelation 14:1 says his name and his Father's name were written on their foreheads.

generalrev.q: In Jude 1:9, what did Michael say to the devil?
options: You are defeated by my sword
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:9 says Michael did not dare to condemn him but said, "The Lord rebuke you."

generalrev.q: Hebrews 9:4 lists which item as inside the ark of the covenant?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 9:4 names the golden jar of manna, Aaron's staff that budded, and the stone tablets.

generalrev.q: For how long did it not rain after Elijah prayed, according to James 5:17?
generalrev.explain: James 5:17 says it did not rain for three years and six months.

generalrev.q: In 2 Peter 3:4, what do the scoffers ask?
generalrev.a: Where is the promise of his coming?
options: Where is the promise of his coming?
Who is the king of glory?
When will the temple be rebuilt?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 3:4 says scoffers ask, "Where is the promise of his coming?"

generalrev.q: In Revelation 22:16, Jesus calls himself the root and offspring of whom?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:16 says, "I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star."

generalrev.q: In Revelation 4:6, in front of the throne there was something like a sea of what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 4:6 describes before the throne a sea of glass, like crystal.

generalrev.q: In the new heaven and new earth of Revelation 21:1, what was no more?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:1 says there was no longer any sea.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 1:25 says the word of the Lord endures for how long?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 1:25 says the word of the Lord endures forever.

generalrev.q: How many wings did each of the four living creatures have in Revelation 4:8?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 4:8 says each of the living creatures had six wings.

generalrev.q: 1 John 3:16 says Jesus laid down his what for us?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 3:16 says Jesus laid down his life for us.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 13:1 says to let what kind of love continue?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:1 says, "Let brotherly love continue."

generalrev.q: In the new city, Revelation 22:4 says God's servants will see what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:4 says they will see his face.

generalrev.q: In John's vision in Revelation 1:16, what came out of Jesus' mouth?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:16 describes a sharp two-edged sword coming out of his mouth.

generalrev.q: James 5:12 says to let your "Yes" be yes and your "No" be what?
generalrev.explain: James 5:12 says to let your yes be yes and your no be no.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:29 says our God is a consuming what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:29 says our God is a consuming fire.

generalrev.q: According to Revelation 7:14, the robes of the great multitude were made white in what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 7:14 says they washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

generalrev.q: Revelation 22:3 says that in the new city there will no longer be any what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 22:3 says no longer will there be any curse.

generalrev.q: In James 2:5, God chose the poor of this world to be rich in what?
generalrev.explain: James 2:5 says God chose the poor to be rich in faith.

generalrev.q: James 3:17 says the wisdom from above is first of all what?
generalrev.explain: James 3:17 says the wisdom from heaven is first pure.

generalrev.q: Which man does 2 Peter 2:5 call a preacher of righteousness?
generalrev.explain: 2 Peter 2:5 calls Noah a preacher of righteousness.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 11:13 says the heroes of faith admitted they were what on the earth?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:13 says they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

generalrev.q: 1 Peter 1:8 says that though we have not seen Jesus, we do what to him?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 1:8 says, though you have not seen him, you love him.

generalrev.q: According to 1 John 5:11, where is the eternal life God has given us found?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 5:11 says this life is in his Son.

generalrev.q: Jude 1:20 says to build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in whom?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:20 says to pray in the Holy Spirit.

generalrev.q: Revelation 12:11 says they overcame by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 12:11 says they overcame by the word of their testimony.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 9:27 says people are appointed to die once, and after that to face what?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 9:27 says that after death comes judgment.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 2:14 says Jesus shared our flesh and blood so that through death he might defeat whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 2:14 says he defeated the one who had the power of death, that is, the devil.

generalrev.q: James 1:13 says God cannot be tempted by what?
generalrev.explain: James 1:13 says God cannot be tempted by evil.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 19:13, the rider on the white horse is named what?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 19:13 says his name is the Word of God.

generalrev.q: According to Hebrews 11:19, Abraham reasoned that God could do what for Isaac?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:19 says Abraham reasoned God could raise people from the dead.

Deuteronomy 6:4.kjv: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:

Genesis 12:2.theme: God promises to bless Abram and make him a blessing
Genesis 12:2.web: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
Genesis 12:2.kjv: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

Genesis 28:15.theme: God promises to be with Jacob and keep him
Genesis 28:15.web: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
Genesis 28:15.kjv: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

Exodus 3:14.theme: God reveals His name: I AM WHO I AM
Exodus 3:14.web: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
Exodus 3:14.kjv: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

Exodus 15:2.theme: The LORD is my strength and song
Exodus 15:2.web: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
Exodus 15:2.kjv: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

Exodus 33:14.theme: God's presence goes with you and gives rest
Exodus 33:14.web: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
Exodus 33:14.kjv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

Numbers 23:19.theme: God is not a man that He should lie
